Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplectic.doc:
**Definition 2.8 (symplectic form).** `ω` is antisymmetric and
nondegenerate (`ω(u, ·) = 0` forces `u = 0`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplectic.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplectic.{u, v} {k : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field k] [AddCommGroup V]
  [Module k V] (ω : LinearMap.BilinForm k V) : Prop
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplectic.source:
/-- **Definition 2.8 (symplectic form).** `ω` is antisymmetric and
nondegenerate (`ω(u, ·) = 0` forces `u = 0`). -/
def IsSymplectic (ω : BilinForm k V) : Prop :=
  (∀ x y, ω x y = -ω y x) ∧ ω.Nondegenerate

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplecticBa.doc:
**Definition 2.8 (symplectic basis).** `e_1, …, e_n, f_1, …, f_n` with
`ω(e_i, f_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(e_i, e_j) = ω(f_i, f_j) = 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplecticBa.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplecticBasis.{u, v} {k : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field k]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] {n : ℕ} (ω : LinearMap.BilinForm k V)
  (b : Module.Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k V) : Prop
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsSymplecticBa.source:
/-- **Definition 2.8 (symplectic basis).** `e_1, …, e_n, f_1, …, f_n` with
`ω(e_i, f_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(e_i, e_j) = ω(f_i, f_j) = 0`. -/
def IsSymplecticBasis {n : ℕ} (ω : BilinForm k V) (b : Basis (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k V) :
    Prop :=
  (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inl i)) (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, ω (b (Sum.inr i)) (b (Sum.inr j)) = 0)

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.doc:
**Convention 2.2, normal form (existence).** Every element of `A_n(k)` can
be written as `∑_j p^j c_j` with `c_j ∈ C`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2_exists.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
  (d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  ∃ L a, (∀ (j : ℕ), a j ∈ C k n) ∧ d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.source:
/-- **Convention 2.2, normal form (existence).** Every element of `A_n(k)` can
be written as `∑_j p^j c_j` with `c_j ∈ C`. -/
theorem convention_2_2_exists (n : ℕ) (d : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    ∃ (L : ℕ) (a : ℕ → PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)), (∀ j, a j ∈ C k n) ∧
      d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j := by
  let b := pairStage_rightOrePBWBasis (B := IteratedPairStage k n)
  let c := b.repr (presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d)
  let L := c.support.sup id + 1
  have hsub : c.support ⊆ Finset.range L := by
    intro j hj
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hj))
  refine ⟨L, fun j => coordinateStageToPresented k n (c j).unop,
    fun j => (C_eq_range k n).symm ▸ ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  have hd : presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, c j • rightPBWMonomial (coordinateDerivation :
        OreDivisionDerivation (CoordinateStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))) j := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← b.linearCombination_repr (presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d)]
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset _ hsub _ (by simp)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp [b, pairStage_rightOrePBWBasis]
    rfl
  have hback : d = stageToPresented k n (presentedToIterated k (n + 1) d) :=
    (DFunLike.congr_fun (iteratedToPresented_comp_presentedToIterated k (n + 1)) d).symm
  rw [hback, hd, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact stageToPresented_rightTerm k n j (c j).unop
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] (n : ℕ)
  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,
        a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
          b =
            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)),
  ∃ L a,
    (∀ (j : ℕ),
        a j ∈
          Algebra.adjoin k
            (↑((RingQuot.liftAlgHom k)
                    ⟨(FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>
                        (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                            ∃ i j,
                              a =
                                  FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                    FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                                b =
                                  (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                    (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                          (FreeAlgebra.ι k
                            (Sum.casesOn i (fun val => Sum.inl val.succ) fun val =>
                              Sum.inr val.succ)),
                      ⋯⟩).range ∪
              {(RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                    ∃ i j,
                      a =
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                        b =
                          (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                            (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                  (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0))})) ∧
      d =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L,
          (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                  ∃ i j,
                    a =
                        FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                      b =
                        (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                          (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr 0)) ^
              j *
            a j

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.doc:
**Convention 2.2, relations.** `x₁` is central in `C`, `[p, x₁] = 1`, and
the transverse algebra commutes with `x₁` and `p`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2_relations.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  p k n * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * p k n + 1 ∧
    (∀ c ∈ C k n, x₁ k n * c = c * x₁ k n) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ transverse k n, t * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * t ∧ t * p k n = p k n * t
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.source:
/-- **Convention 2.2, relations.** `x₁` is central in `C`, `[p, x₁] = 1`, and
the transverse algebra commutes with `x₁` and `p`. -/
theorem convention_2_2_relations (n : ℕ) :
    p k n * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * p k n + 1 ∧
      (∀ c ∈ C k n, x₁ k n * c = c * x₁ k n) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ transverse k n, t * x₁ k n = x₁ k n * t ∧ t * p k n = p k n * t := by
  refine ⟨presentedMomentum_mul_coordinate k n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c hc
    induction hc using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
        rcases hx with ⟨w, rfl⟩ | hx
        · exact presentedCoordinate_commutes_previous k n w
        · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx]
    | algebraMap r => exact (Algebra.commutes r _).symm
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy]
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [← mul_assoc, hx, mul_assoc, hy, mul_assoc]
  · rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(presentedCoordinate_commutes_previous k n w).symm,
      (presentedMomentum_commutes_previous k n w).symm⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.doc:
**Convention 2.2, normal form (uniqueness).** If `∑_{j<L} p^j c_j = 0`
with `c_j ∈ C`, then every `c_j = 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2_unique.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n L : ℕ)
  (a : ℕ → WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) (ha : ∀ (j : ℕ), a j ∈ C k n)
  (h0 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j = 0) (j : ℕ) : j < L → a j = 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.convention_2_2.source:
/-- **Convention 2.2, normal form (uniqueness).** If `∑_{j<L} p^j c_j = 0`
with `c_j ∈ C`, then every `c_j = 0`. -/
theorem convention_2_2_unique (n L : ℕ) (a : ℕ → PresentedWeyl k (n + 1))
    (ha : ∀ j, a j ∈ C k n) (h0 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, p k n ^ j * a j = 0) :
    ∀ j < L, a j = 0 := by
  have hpre : ∀ j, ∃ z, coordinateStageToPresented k n z = a j := fun j => by
    have := ha j
    rw [C_eq_range] at this
    exact this
  choose b hb using hpre
  let D : OreDivisionDerivation (CoordinateStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n)) :=
    coordinateDerivation
  have hsum : rightPBWCombination D
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, Finsupp.single j (MulOpposite.op (b j))) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [rightPBWCombination_single]
    have himg : stageToPresented k n
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, MulOpposite.op (b j) • rightPBWMonomial D j) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sum, ← h0]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [stageToPresented_rightTerm, hb]
    have := congrArg (presentedToIterated k (n + 1)) himg
    rwa [presentedToIterated_stageToPresented, map_zero] at this
  have hzero := (rightPBWCombination_injective D) (hsum.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  intro j hj
  have hj' := congrArg (fun f : ℕ →₀ (CoordinateStage (B := IteratedPairStage k n))ᵐᵒᵖ => f j)
    hzero
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_range, ite_eq_left hj, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hj'
  rw [← hb, MulOpposite.op_injective (hj'.trans MulOpposite.op_zero.symm), map_zero]

                        (FreeAlgebra.ι k
                          (Sum.casesOn i (fun val => Sum.inl val.succ) fun val =>

            {(RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                  ∃ i j,
                    a =
                        FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                      b =
                        (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                          (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0))})) →
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L,
          (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                  ∃ i j,

theorem grCyclic_good {n : ℕ} (I : RightIdeal (PresentedWeyl k n)) :

**`gr A_n(k) = k[x, ξ]`** for the Bernstein and the order filtration
(any weight): `⊕_j F_j/F_{j-1}` is identified with the polynomial ring by

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.grEquivSymbolR.source:
/-- **`gr A_n(k) = k[x, ξ]`** for the Bernstein and the order filtration
(any weight): `⊕_j F_j/F_{j-1}` is identified with the polynomial ring by
summing the homogeneous symbols.  Multiplication of classes is the product of
symbols, `σ_{i+j}(ab) = σ_i(a)σ_j(b)`
(`WeylLeadingSymbol.presentedPrincipalComponent_mul_bernstein`,
`presentedPrincipalComponent_mul_order`), so `gr A_n(k)` is commutative. -/
def grEquivSymbolRing {n : ℕ} (w : PhaseVar n → ℕ) :
    gr (presentedWeightPiece k w) ≃ₗ[k] SymbolRing k n := by
  letI := MvPolynomial.weightedDecomposition k w
  exact (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun j => grPieceEquiv k w j).trans
    (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)).symm

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.doc:
**Definition 2.8 (standard symplectic form).** On `𝕍 = k^{2n}` with basis
`x_1, …, x_n, ∂_1, …, ∂_n`, `ω(u, v) = ∑_i (u_{x_i} v_{∂_i} - u_{∂_i} v_{x_i})`,
so `ω(x_i, ∂_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(x_i, x_j) = ω(∂_i, ∂_j) = 0`.  It is the
negative of the repository's `phasePairing`, which uses the opposite sign
convention.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  LinearMap.BilinForm k (Characteristic.PhaseVar n → k)
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.omega.source:
/-- **Definition 2.8 (standard symplectic form).** On `𝕍 = k^{2n}` with basis
`x_1, …, x_n, ∂_1, …, ∂_n`, `ω(u, v) = ∑_i (u_{x_i} v_{∂_i} - u_{∂_i} v_{x_i})`,
so `ω(x_i, ∂_j) = δ_ij` and `ω(x_i, x_j) = ω(∂_i, ∂_j) = 0`.  It is the
negative of the repository's `phasePairing`, which uses the opposite sign
convention. -/
def omega (n : ℕ) : BilinForm k (PhaseVar n → k) :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ k (fun u v => -phasePairing k u v)
    (fun u v w => by rw [phasePairing_add_left, neg_add])
    (fun c u v => by rw [phasePairing_smul_left, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg])
    (fun u v w => by rw [phasePairing_add_right, neg_add])
    (fun c u v => by rw [phasePairing_smul_right, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg])

  toFun a := MulOpposite.op a • q

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.poisson.source:
/-- **Definition 2.9 (Poisson bracket).**
`{f, g} = ∑_i (∂f/∂x_i ∂g/∂ξ_i - ∂f/∂ξ_i ∂g/∂x_i)` on `k[x, ξ]`. -/
def poisson {n : ℕ} (f g : SymbolRing k n) : SymbolRing k n :=
  ∑ i : Fin n,
    (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i) f * MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i) g -
      MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i) f * MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i) g)

generated over `K[x, ξ]`).  Then `J = √(Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr M)` is involutive.  The cited result

modules and the repository's proof of the cyclic case.

  [Module.Finite (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg K n)ᵐᵒᵖ M] (Γ : ℕ → Submodule K M)

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_11.source:
/-- **Theorem 2.11 (Gabber).** Let `K` be a field of characteristic zero and `M`
a finitely generated right `A_n(K)`-module with a good order filtration `M_•`
(Definition 2.4, `IsGoodFiltration`: compatible and exhaustive, `gr M` finitely
generated over `K[x, ξ]`).  Then `J = √(Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr M)` is involutive.  The cited result
[Gab81] is proved in `Stafford38.Paper.Support.Gabber`, by reduction to cyclic
modules and the repository's proof of the cyclic case. -/
theorem theorem_2_11 (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] (n : ℕ)
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg K n)ᵐᵒᵖ M] [Module K M]
    [IsScalarTower K (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg K n)ᵐᵒᵖ M]
    [Module.Finite (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg K n)ᵐᵒᵖ M]
    (Γ : ℕ → Submodule K M) (hgood : IsGoodFiltration K n Γ) :
    IsInvolutive K (Module.annihilator (SymbolRing K n)
      (Stafford38.Paper.Support.Gabber.GrModule Γ)).radical :=
  (isInvolutive_iff K _).2 (Stafford38.Paper.Support.Gabber.theorem_2_11_general K n Γ
    hgood.compatible hgood.finite)

      M]
  [inst_4 : Module K M]
  [inst_5 :
    IsScalarTower K
      (RingQuot fun a b =>
          ∃ i j,
            a = FreeAlgebra.ι K i * FreeAlgebra.ι K j - FreeAlgebra.ι K j * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∧
              b = (algebraMap K (FreeAlgebra K (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))) (Matrix.J (Fin n) K i j))ᵐᵒᵖ
      M]
  [Module.Finite
      (RingQuot fun a b =>
          ∃ i j,
            a = FreeAlgebra.ι K i * FreeAlgebra.ι K j - FreeAlgebra.ι K j * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∧
              b = (algebraMap K (FreeAlgebra K (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))) (Matrix.J (Fin n) K i j))ᵐᵒᵖ
      M]
  (Γ : ℕ → Submodule K M),
  IsGoodFiltration K n Γ →
    ∀

      ∀
        g ∈
          (Module.annihilator (MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) K)
              (DirectSum ℕ fun j =>
                ↥(Γ j) ⧸ Submodule.comap (Γ j).subtype (Nat.casesOn j ⊥ fun n => Γ n))).radical,
        ∑ i,
            ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) g -

Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.doc:
**Theorem 2.12 (Hilbert's Nullstellensatz).** Let `K` be algebraically
closed and `J ⊆ K[z_1, …, z_N]` an ideal (the variables indexed by any
finite type `σ`, e.g. `PhaseVar n` for `K[x, ξ]`).
(a) The maximal ideals of `K[z]` are exactly the `𝔪_a`, `a ↦ 𝔪_a` is
injective, and `V_K(J)` corresponds to the closed points of `V(J)`;
(b) `V_K(J) = ∅` iff `1 ∈ J`;
(c) `I(V_K(J)) = √J`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.{u, v} (K : Type u) [Field K] {σ : Type v} [IsAlgClosed K]
  [Finite σ] (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) :
  ((∀ (M : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)), M.IsMaximal ↔ ∃ a, M = maxIdealAt K a) ∧
      Function.Injective (maxIdealAt K) ∧ ∀ (a : σ → K), a ∈ VK K J ↔ closedPoint K a ∈ V J) ∧
    (VK K J = ∅ ↔ 1 ∈ J) ∧ vanishingIdealOf K (VK K J) = J.radical
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.source:
/-- **Theorem 2.12 (Hilbert's Nullstellensatz).** Let `K` be algebraically
closed and `J ⊆ K[z_1, …, z_N]` an ideal (the variables indexed by any
finite type `σ`, e.g. `PhaseVar n` for `K[x, ξ]`).
(a) The maximal ideals of `K[z]` are exactly the `𝔪_a`, `a ↦ 𝔪_a` is
injective, and `V_K(J)` corresponds to the closed points of `V(J)`;
(b) `V_K(J) = ∅` iff `1 ∈ J`;
(c) `I(V_K(J)) = √J`. -/
theorem theorem_2_12 [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite σ] (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) :
    ((∀ M : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K), M.IsMaximal ↔ ∃ a, M = maxIdealAt K a) ∧
      Function.Injective (maxIdealAt K (σ := σ)) ∧
      ∀ a, a ∈ VK K J ↔ closedPoint K a ∈ V J) ∧
    (VK K J = ∅ ↔ (1 : MvPolynomial σ K) ∈ J) ∧
    vanishingIdealOf K (VK K J) = J.radical := by
  have hc : vanishingIdealOf K (VK K J) = J.radical := by
    rw [vanishingIdealOf, VK_eq_zeroLocus, MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical]
  refine ⟨⟨fun M => ?_, ?_, mem_VK_iff_closedPoint_mem_V K J⟩, ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩, hc⟩
  · simp only [maxIdealAt_eq_vanishingIdeal]
    exact MvPolynomial.isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton
  · intro a b hab
    funext i
    have hmem : MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (a i) ∈ maxIdealAt K b :=
      hab ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_maxIdealAt_iff] at hmem
    simpa [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] using hmem
  · have h1 : (1 : MvPolynomial σ K) ∈ J.radical := by
      rw [← hc, h, mem_vanishingIdealOf]
      simp
    exact (Ideal.radical_eq_top.mp ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr h1)).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  · ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro ha
    simpa using ha 1 h
Stafford38.Paper.Section2.theorem_2_12.unfolded:
∀ (K : Type u) [inst : Field K] {σ : Type v} [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite σ]
  (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)),
  ((∀ (M : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)),
        M.IsMaximal ↔
          ∃ a, M = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (a i))) ∧
      (Function.Injective fun a =>
          Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (a i))) ∧
        ∀ (a : σ → K),
          a ∈ {a | ∀ f ∈ J, (MvPolynomial.eval a) f = 0} ↔
            { asIdeal := Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (a i)),
                isPrime := ⋯ } ∈
              PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ↑J) ∧
    ({a | ∀ f ∈ J, (MvPolynomial.eval a) f = 0} = ∅ ↔ 1 ∈ J) ∧
      MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal K {a | ∀ f ∈ J, (MvPolynomial.eval a) f = 0} = J.radical

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.IsMonicNormalF.source:
/-- **Equation (3.1).** `d̃ = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j` with `a_j ∈ C` and
`deg_B a_j ≤ N - j`. -/
def IsMonicNormalForm {n : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : ℕ → PresentedWeyl k (n + 1),
    (∀ j < N, a j ∈ C k n ∧ bernsteinDegree k (a j) ≤ N - j) ∧
      dt = p k n ^ N + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, p k n ^ j * a j

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.exists_eq_of_Q.doc: `Q = 0` gives `1 ∈ 𝓘`, i.e. `1 = d̃R + x₁^N d̃S` for some `R, S`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.exists_eq_of_Q.source:
/-- `Q = 0` gives `1 ∈ 𝓘`, i.e. `1 = d̃R + x₁^N d̃S` for some `R, S`. -/
theorem exists_eq_of_Q_eq_zero {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hQ : Subsingleton (Q k N dt)) :
    ∃ R S : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1), (1 : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) =
      dt * R + x₁ k n ^ N * dt * S := by
  have hmem : (1 : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) ∈ idealI k N dt := by
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (idealI k N dt)).mp
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp hmem
  refine ⟨a.unop, b.unop, ?_⟩
  rw [← hab]
  rfl

              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)},
  Subsingleton
      ((RingQuot fun a b =>
          ∃ i j,

              b =
                (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                  (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)) ⧸
        Submodule.span
          (RingQuot fun a b =>
              ∃ i j,
                a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                  b =
                    (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                      (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))ᵐᵒᵖ
          {dt,
            (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                    ∃ i j,
                      a =
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5.doc:
**Lemma 3.5.** Let `d̃ = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j` with `a_j ∈ C`,
`deg_B a_j ≤ N - j` as in (3.1), and `N = deg_B d̃`.  Then `d̃` has order `N`,
and its order principal symbol is a polynomial in `ξ` alone,
`σ_N^ord(d̃) = P(ξ)` with `P ∈ k[ξ_1, …, ξ_n]`, `deg P = N` (eq. (3.3)); `P` is
homogeneous, monic of degree `N` in `ξ₁`, and `P(1, 0, …, 0) = 1`
(eq. (3.4)).
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] {n N : ℕ}
  {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt)
  (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
  (dt ∈ WeylFiltration.orderPiece k (n + 1) N ∧
      ∀ j < N, dt ∉ WeylFiltration.orderPiece k (n + 1) j) ∧
    ∃ P,
      orderSymbol k N dt = (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr) P ∧
        P.IsHomogeneous N ∧
          P.totalDegree = N ∧
            IsMonicInXi1 k N P ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) P = 1
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5.source:
/-- **Lemma 3.5.** Let `d̃ = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j` with `a_j ∈ C`,
`deg_B a_j ≤ N - j` as in (3.1), and `N = deg_B d̃`.  Then `d̃` has order `N`,
and its order principal symbol is a polynomial in `ξ` alone,
`σ_N^ord(d̃) = P(ξ)` with `P ∈ k[ξ_1, …, ξ_n]`, `deg P = N` (eq. (3.3)); `P` is
homogeneous, monic of degree `N` in `ξ₁`, and `P(1, 0, …, 0) = 1`
(eq. (3.4)). -/
theorem lemma_3_5 {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt)
    (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
    (dt ∈ orderPiece k (n + 1) N ∧ ∀ j < N, dt ∉ orderPiece k (n + 1) j) ∧
      ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k,
        orderSymbol k N dt = MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr P ∧
          P.IsHomogeneous N ∧ P.totalDegree = N ∧ IsMonicInXi1 k N P ∧
          MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) P = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨hF, hfibre, hhom⟩ := step_3_5_fibre k hdeg
  obtain ⟨P, hsP, hP⟩ := step_3_5_fibre_polynomial k hfibre hhom
  have hpure := step_3_5_pure_coefficient k hform
  have hne : orderSymbol k N dt ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hpure
    simp at hpure
  have hcoeff : MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 N) P = 1 := by
    have h := MvPolynomial.coeff_rename_mapDomain
      (Sum.inr : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1)) Sum.inr_injective P
      (Finsupp.single 0 N)
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, ← hsP] at h
    simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff] using h.symm.trans hpure
  obtain ⟨hmonic, htot, heval⟩ := step_3_5_monic k hP hcoeff
  exact ⟨step_3_5_order k hF hne, P, hsP, hP, htot, hmonic, heval⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5_eval.doc:
Equation (3.4) read in `k[x, ξ]`: `σ_N^ord(d̃)` takes the value `1` at the
covector `ξ = (1, 0, …, 0)` over every base point `x = 0`, i.e. at
`axisPoint (.inr 0)`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5_eval.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5_eval_axis.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] {n N : ℕ}
  {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt)
  (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
  (MvPolynomial.eval (CharacteristicHomogeneousChart.axisPoint k (Sum.inr 0)))
      (orderSymbol k N dt) =
    1
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.lemma_3_5_eval.source:
/-- Equation (3.4) read in `k[x, ξ]`: `σ_N^ord(d̃)` takes the value `1` at the
covector `ξ = (1, 0, …, 0)` over every base point `x = 0`, i.e. at
`axisPoint (.inr 0)`. -/
theorem lemma_3_5_eval_axis {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (axisPoint k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1)))) (orderSymbol k N dt) = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨-, P, hsP, -, -, -, heval⟩ := lemma_3_5 k hform hdeg
  have hpt : (axisPoint k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1))) ∘ Sum.inr : Fin (n + 1) → k) =
      fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    funext i
    simp [axisPoint]
  rw [hsP, MvPolynomial.eval_rename, hpt]
  exact heval

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.doc:
**Proposition 3.2.** Let `0 ≠ d ∈ A_n(k)` with `N := deg_B d ≥ 1`.  There
are an automorphism `Φ_g` of `A_n(k)` and `c ∈ k^×` with
`d̃ := c⁻¹ Φ_g(d) = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j`, `a_j ∈ C`, `deg_B a_j ≤ N - j`
(eq. (3.1)), and `deg_B d̃ = N`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_2.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] {n : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hd : d ≠ 0)
  (hN : 1 ≤ bernsteinDegree k d) :
  ∃ g c,
    c ≠ 0 ∧
      IsMonicNormalForm k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d) ∧
        bernsteinDegree k (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d) = bernsteinDegree k d
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.source:
/-- **Proposition 3.2.** Let `0 ≠ d ∈ A_n(k)` with `N := deg_B d ≥ 1`.  There
are an automorphism `Φ_g` of `A_n(k)` and `c ∈ k^×` with
`d̃ := c⁻¹ Φ_g(d) = p^N + ∑_{j<N} p^j a_j`, `a_j ∈ C`, `deg_B a_j ≤ N - j`
(eq. (3.1)), and `deg_B d̃ = N`. -/
theorem proposition_3_2 [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} {d : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hN : 1 ≤ bernsteinDegree k d) :
    ∃ (g : Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin (n + 1)) k) (c : k), c ≠ 0 ∧
      IsMonicNormalForm k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) ∧
      bernsteinDegree k (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) = bernsteinDegree k d := by
  obtain ⟨hpiece, hne, hhom, -, -⟩ := bernsteinSymbol_ne_zero k hd
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := step_3_2_nonvanishing k hhom hne hN
  obtain ⟨h, hpres, hhe⟩ := step_3_2_h k hv0 (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1)))
  obtain ⟨g, -, hmul⟩ := step_3_2_transpose k h hpres
  obtain ⟨hpiece', heval, hdeg'⟩ := step_3_2_symbol k g hpiece (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1)))
  rw [hmul, hhe] at heval hdeg'
  obtain ⟨hpiece'', hdeg'', hval⟩ := step_3_2_normalize k hpiece' (hdeg' hv) _ hv heval
  exact ⟨g, _, hv, step_3_2_monic k hpiece'' hval, hdeg''⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.doc:
**Proposition 3.6.** Equip `Q` with the order filtration `Q_m = qF_m`
induced by the cyclic generator `q = [1]`, and write `P = σ_N^ord(d̃)`.  Then
`P ∈ Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q` (eq. (3.5)).
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_6.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] {n N : ℕ}
  {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt)
  (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
  orderSymbol k N dt ∈ Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt)
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.proposition_3_.source:
/-- **Proposition 3.6.** Equip `Q` with the order filtration `Q_m = qF_m`
induced by the cyclic generator `q = [1]`, and write `P = σ_N^ord(d̃)`.  Then
`P ∈ Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q` (eq. (3.5)). -/
theorem proposition_3_6 {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
    orderSymbol k N dt ∈ Module.annihilator (SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hF, -⟩, -⟩ := lemma_3_5 k hform hdeg
  rw [Module.mem_annihilator]
  intro m
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (step_3_6_generated k dt).2.2 m
  rw [smul_comm, step_3_6_kills k hF, smul_zero]

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.remark_3_3.doc:
**Remark 3.3.** Since `Φ_g` is a ring automorphism and `c` a central unit,
`1 = d̃R + x₁^N d̃S` for `d̃ = c⁻¹Φ_g(d)` transports back to
`1 = d (c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(R)) + F d (c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(S))` with `F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^N`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.remark_3_3.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.remark_3_3.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] {n N : ℕ}
  (g : ↥(Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin (n + 1)) k)) (c : k)
  (d R S : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1))
  (h : 1 = c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d * R + Section2.x₁ k n ^ N * c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d * S) :
  1 =
    d * c⁻¹ • (phiG k g).symm R +
      (phiG k g).symm (Section2.x₁ k n) ^ N * d * c⁻¹ • (phiG k g).symm S
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.remark_3_3.source:
/-- **Remark 3.3.** Since `Φ_g` is a ring automorphism and `c` a central unit,
`1 = d̃R + x₁^N d̃S` for `d̃ = c⁻¹Φ_g(d)` transports back to
`1 = d (c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(R)) + F d (c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(S))` with `F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^N`. -/
theorem remark_3_3 {n N : ℕ} (g : Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin (n + 1)) k) (c : k)
    (d R S : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1))
    (h : (1 : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) =
      (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) * R + x₁ k n ^ N * (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) * S) :
    (1 : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) =
      d * (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g).symm R) +
        (phiG k g).symm (x₁ k n) ^ N * d * (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g).symm S) := by
  have ht := congrArg (phiG k g).symm h
  rw [map_one] at ht
  rw [ht, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_smul, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.remark_3_3.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] {n N : ℕ} (g : ↥(Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin (n + 1)) k)) (c : k)
  (d R S :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,
        a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
          b =
            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)),
  1 =
      c⁻¹ •
            { toFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                invFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g⁻¹) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ }
              d *
          R +
        (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                  ∃ i j,
                    a =
                        FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                      b =
                        (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                          (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0)) ^
              N *
            c⁻¹ •
              { toFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  invFun :=
                    ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g⁻¹) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ }
                d *
          S →
    1 =
      d *
          c⁻¹ •
            { toFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  invFun :=
                    ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g⁻¹) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ }.symm
              R +
        { toFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                    invFun :=
                      ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g⁻¹) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                    left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯,
                    commutes' := ⋯ }.symm
                ((RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                    ∃ i j,
                      a =
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                        b =
                          (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                            (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                  (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0))) ^
              N *
            d *
          c⁻¹ •
            { toFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  invFun :=
                    ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g⁻¹) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ }.symm
              S

              b =
                (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                  (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)) ⧸
        Submodule.span
          (RingQuot fun a b =>
              ∃ i j,
                a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                  b =
                    (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                      (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))ᵐᵒᵖ
          {c⁻¹ •
              { toFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  invFun :=
                    ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g⁻¹) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                  left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ }
                d,
            (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                    ∃ i j,
                      a =
                          FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                        b =
                          (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                            (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                  (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0)) ^
                N *
              c⁻¹ •
                { toFun := ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                    invFun :=
                      ⇑(Stafford.freeWeylSymplecticAlgHom (↑g⁻¹) (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) ⋯),
                    left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯, commutes' := ⋯ }
                  d}) →
    ∃ ell R S,
      (∃ M N,
          ∃ (_ : M * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * M.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ :
            N * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * N.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ : M * N = 1)
            (_ : N * M = 1),
            ell =
              ∑ j,
                (algebraMap k
                      (RingQuot fun a b =>
                        ∃ i j,
                          a =
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                            b =
                              (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)))
                    (N (Sum.inl 0) j) *
                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                      ∃ i j,
                        a =
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                          b =
                            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                    (FreeAlgebra.ι k j)) ∧
        1 = d * R + ell ^ N * d * S

Stafford38.Paper.Section3.section_3_redu.doc:
**Section 3 for the final assembly.**  For `0 ≠ d ∈ A_n(k)`, either
`deg_B d = 0` and `d` is a unit with `1 = dR + FdS` (opening paragraph), or
`N = deg_B d ≥ 1` and Proposition 3.2 gives the normal form `d̃ = c⁻¹Φ_g(d)`
of (3.1) with `deg_B d̃ = N`, for which `Q = A/𝓘 = 0` yields
`1 = dR + ℓ^N dS` with a linear symplectic coordinate `ℓ` (Remark 3.3).
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.section_3_redu.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.section_3_reduction.{u} (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] {n : ℕ}
  {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
  bernsteinDegree k d = 0 ∧ Stafford.Reduction.Stafford38 d ∨
    1 ≤ bernsteinDegree k d ∧
      ∃ g c,
        c ≠ 0 ∧
          IsMonicNormalForm k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d) ∧
            bernsteinDegree k (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d) = bernsteinDegree k d ∧
              (Subsingleton (Q k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • (phiG k g) d)) →
                ∃ ell R S,
                  Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.IsLinearWeylCoordinate k n ell ∧
                    1 = d * R + ell ^ bernsteinDegree k d * d * S)
Stafford38.Paper.Section3.section_3_redu.source:
/-- **Section 3 for the final assembly.**  For `0 ≠ d ∈ A_n(k)`, either
`deg_B d = 0` and `d` is a unit with `1 = dR + FdS` (opening paragraph), or
`N = deg_B d ≥ 1` and Proposition 3.2 gives the normal form `d̃ = c⁻¹Φ_g(d)`
of (3.1) with `deg_B d̃ = N`, for which `Q = A/𝓘 = 0` yields
`1 = dR + ℓ^N dS` with a linear symplectic coordinate `ℓ` (Remark 3.3). -/
theorem section_3_reduction [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} {d : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (bernsteinDegree k d = 0 ∧ Stafford.Reduction.Stafford38 d) ∨
      (1 ≤ bernsteinDegree k d ∧
        ∃ (g : Matrix.symplecticGroup (Fin (n + 1)) k) (c : k), c ≠ 0 ∧
          IsMonicNormalForm k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) ∧
          bernsteinDegree k (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d) = bernsteinDegree k d ∧
          (Subsingleton (Q k (bernsteinDegree k d) (c⁻¹ • phiG k g d)) →
            ∃ ell R S : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1),
              Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.IsLinearWeylCoordinate k n ell ∧
                (1 : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) = d * R + ell ^ bernsteinDegree k d * d * S)) := by
  by_cases hN : bernsteinDegree k d = 0
  · obtain ⟨c, -, -, hcert⟩ := step_scalar_case k hd hN
    exact Or.inl ⟨hN, 1, _, 0, hcert⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, c, hc, hform, hdeg⟩ := proposition_3_2 k hd (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hN)
    exact Or.inr ⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hN, g, c, hc, hform, hdeg,
      remark_3_3_of_Q_eq_zero k g c d⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.doc:
**Corollary 4.11.** Multiplication by `x₁` on `gr Q` is surjective, i.e.
`gr Q = (gr Q) x₁`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1) with `N ≥ 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.{u_1} {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Algebra ℚ k]
  {n N : ℕ} {d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hN : 0 < N)
  (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) : Function.Surjective fun z => symbolCoordinate k n • z
Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.source:
/-- **Corollary 4.11.** Multiplication by `x₁` on `gr Q` is surjective, i.e.
`gr Q = (gr Q) x₁`, for `d̃` in the form (3.1) with `N ≥ 1`. -/
theorem corollary_4_11 (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Function.Surjective (fun z : GrQ k n N d => symbolCoordinate k n • z) := by
  have hU := step_4_11_cokernel_zero hN hform
  have htop : LinearMap.range (coordinateMap k n N d) = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mp hU
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp htop z
  exact ⟨w, (setup_coordinateMap_apply k n N d w).symm.trans hw⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section4.corollary_4_11.source:
/-- Corollary 4.11 in the form `M/x₁M = 0` over `k[x,ξ]` (`QuotSMulTop`), as
consumed by the support-avoidance argument of Section 6. -/
theorem corollary_4_11_quotSMulTop (hN : 0 < N)
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N d) :
    Subsingleton (QuotSMulTop (symbolCoordinate k n) (GrQ k n N d)) := by
  have hsurj := corollary_4_11 hN hform
  change Subsingleton (GrQ k n N d ⧸ symbolCoordinate k n • (⊤ : Submodule (Symbol k n) _))
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff, eq_top_iff]
  intro z _
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hsurj z
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul w _ ⊤ trivial

Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.doc:
**Theorem 5.8.** Let `K` be algebraically closed of characteristic zero and
`W ⊆ T*X` Zariski closed, fibre-conical and involutive.  If
`P ∈ K[ξ_1, …, ξ_n]` with `P(1, 0, …, 0) ≠ 0` vanishes on `W` and
`W ∩ π⁻¹(H) = ∅`, then `W = ∅`.  Proved along Subsection 5.3.
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
  {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (W : Set (Characteristic.PhaseVar m → k))
  (hclosed : ∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
  (hcone : Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical W)
  (hinv : Characteristic.PostScalarExtensionPoisson.IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
  (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
  (haxis : (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) P ≠ 0)
  (hPW : ∀ q ∈ W, (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inr i)) P = 0)
  (hH : W ∩ {q | q (Sum.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅) : W = ∅
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.source:
/-- **Theorem 5.8.** Let `K` be algebraically closed of characteristic zero and
`W ⊆ T*X` Zariski closed, fibre-conical and involutive.  If
`P ∈ K[ξ_1, …, ξ_n]` with `P(1, 0, …, 0) ≠ 0` vanishes on `W` and
`W ∩ π⁻¹(H) = ∅`, then `W = ∅`.  Proved along Subsection 5.3. -/
theorem theorem_5_8
    (hm : 0 < m) (W : Set (PhaseVar m → k))
    (hclosed : ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing k m), W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L)
    (hcone : IsFibreConical W)
    (hinv : IsInvolutive (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W))
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k)
    (haxis : MvPolynomial.eval
      (fun i : Fin m => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then (1 : k) else 0) P ≠ 0)
    (hPW : ∀ q ∈ W, MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => q (.inr i)) P = 0)
    (hH : W ∩ {q | q (.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅) :
    W = ∅ := by
  -- Suppose `W ≠ ∅`.
  by_contra hne
  have hW : W.Nonempty := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hne
  -- `B` is radical with a minimal prime `𝔮`; `Y_0 = V_K(𝔮)`.
  obtain ⟨hrad, -, -, 𝔮, h𝔮⟩ := step_minimal_primes W hclosed hcone hW
  obtain ⟨hprime, -, -, -, havoid⟩ := step_component hm W hclosed hcone hH 𝔮 h𝔮
  -- The separator `s`, then `P` vanishes on `N(Y_0)`.
  obtain ⟨s, hs𝔮, hs⟩ := step_separator W 𝔮 hrad h𝔮
  have hPN := step_P_vanishes_on_conormal_cone W hclosed hcone hinv 𝔮 h𝔮 s hs𝔮 hs P hPW
  -- Theorem 5.7(i) contradicts `P(1, 0, …, 0) ≠ 0`.
  exact haxis (step_theorem_5_7_applies hm 𝔮 hprime havoid P
    (step_P_vanishes_on_N 𝔮 hprime P hPN))
Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8.unfolded:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (W : Set (Fin m ⊕ Fin m → k)),
  (∃ L, W = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus k L) →
    (∀ q ∈ W,
        ∀ (a : k), a ≠ 0 → (Sum.elim (fun i => q (Sum.inl i)) fun i => a * q (Sum.inr i)) ∈ W) →
      (∀ f ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
          ∀ g ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W,
            ∑ i,
                ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) g -
                  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr i)) f * (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl i)) g) ∈
              MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k W) →
        ∀ (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
          (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => if i = ⟨0, hm⟩ then 1 else 0) P ≠ 0 →
            (∀ q ∈ W, (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inr i)) P = 0) →
              W ∩ {q | q (Sum.inl ⟨0, hm⟩) = 0} = ∅ → W = ∅

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.IsStablyGenera.doc:
Stafford's notion [Sta78, p. 435]: `T` is *stably `m`-generated* if for
every `l ≥ m` and generators `a_1, …, a_{l+1}` of `T` there are `f_i ∈ A` such
that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`, `i = 1, …, l`, generate `T`.  Stably cyclic is `m = 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.IsStablyGenera.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.IsStablyGenerated.{u, v} (A : Type u) [Ring A] (T : Type v)
  [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] (m : ℕ) : Prop
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.IsStablyGenera.source:
/-- Stafford's notion [Sta78, p. 435]: `T` is *stably `m`-generated* if for
every `l ≥ m` and generators `a_1, …, a_{l+1}` of `T` there are `f_i ∈ A` such
that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`, `i = 1, …, l`, generate `T`.  Stably cyclic is `m = 1`. -/
def IsStablyGenerated (A : Type u) [Ring A] (T : Type v) [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T]
    (m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ≥ m, ∀ a : Fin (l + 1) → T, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range a) = ⊤ →
    ∃ f : Fin l → A, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (Set.range fun i : Fin l => a i.castSucc + (MulOpposite.op (f i) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a (Fin.last l)) =
        ⊤

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.corollary_6_3_.doc:
**Proof of Corollary 6.3**, given the cited theorem [Sta78, Thm. 3.7]
(`h37`: `T` is generated by two elements and stably two-generated).  Take
generators `t₁, t₂` (`h37`), `φ(r, s) = t₁r + t₂s` onto `T`, a common
annihilator `d = d₁r₁ = d₂r₂` (Ore condition), `1 = dR + FdS`; then
`(a, 1 - Fa) ∈ M = ker φ` and `(a, 1 - Fa), (1, -F)` generate `A ⊕ A`, so `T`
is generated by `φ(1, -F) = t₁ - t₂F`.  The closing remark, stable
cyclicity: for `l = 1` choose `f_1 = -F` (`step_6_3_pair`); for `l ≥ 2` it is
the stable two-generation of `h37`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.corollary_6_3_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.corollary_6_3_of.{u, v} {A : Type u} [Ring A] {T : Type v}
  [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T]
  (hOre : AlgebraicAnalysis.OreRightIntersection.RightOreCondition A)
  (hone : ∀ (d : A), d ≠ 0 → ∃ F R S, 1 = d * R + F * d * S) (htorsion : IsTorsion A T)
  (h37 : (∃ t₁ t₂, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {t₁, t₂} = ⊤) ∧ IsStablyGenerated A T 2) :
  Section2.IsCyclic A T ∧ IsStablyGenerated A T 1
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.corollary_6_3_.source:
/-- **Proof of Corollary 6.3**, given the cited theorem [Sta78, Thm. 3.7]
(`h37`: `T` is generated by two elements and stably two-generated).  Take
generators `t₁, t₂` (`h37`), `φ(r, s) = t₁r + t₂s` onto `T`, a common
annihilator `d = d₁r₁ = d₂r₂` (Ore condition), `1 = dR + FdS`; then
`(a, 1 - Fa) ∈ M = ker φ` and `(a, 1 - Fa), (1, -F)` generate `A ⊕ A`, so `T`
is generated by `φ(1, -F) = t₁ - t₂F`.  The closing remark, stable
cyclicity: for `l = 1` choose `f_1 = -F` (`step_6_3_pair`); for `l ≥ 2` it is
the stable two-generation of `h37`. -/
theorem corollary_6_3_of (hOre : RightOreCondition A)
    (hone : ∀ d : A, d ≠ 0 → ∃ F R S : A, (1 : A) = d * R + F * d * S)
    (htorsion : Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsTorsion A T)
    (h37 : (∃ t₁ t₂ : T, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ ({t₁, t₂} : Set T) = ⊤) ∧
      IsStablyGenerated A T 2) :
    Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsCyclic A T ∧ IsStablyGenerated A T 1 := by
  obtain ⟨⟨t₁, t₂, ht⟩, h2⟩ := h37
  obtain ⟨d, hd, h₁, h₂⟩ := step_6_3_common_annihilator hOre htorsion t₁ t₂
  obtain ⟨F, R, S, hcert⟩ := hone d hd
  refine ⟨(Stafford38.Paper.Section2.isCyclic_iff_span A T).2
    ⟨_, (step_6_3_pair t₁ t₂ d F R S h₁ h₂ hcert).trans ht⟩, ?_⟩
  intro l hl a ha
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge l 2 with hl2 | hl2
  · obtain rfl : l = 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨d', hd', h₁', h₂'⟩ := step_6_3_common_annihilator hOre htorsion (a 0) (a 1)
    obtain ⟨F', R', S', hcert'⟩ := hone d' hd'
    refine ⟨fun _ => -F', ?_⟩
    have hrange : (Set.range fun i : Fin 1 =>
        a i.castSucc + (MulOpposite.op (-F') : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a (Fin.last 1)) =
        {a 0 - (MulOpposite.op F' : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a 1} := by
      ext z
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg, Fin.last]
      exact eq_comm
    have hpair2 : ({a 0, a 1} : Set T) = Set.range a := by
      ext z
      simp [Fin.exists_fin_two, eq_comm]
    rw [hrange, step_6_3_pair (a 0) (a 1) d' F' R' S' h₁' h₂' hcert', hpair2, ha]
  · exact h2 l hl2 a ha

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.lemma_6_2.doc:
**Lemma 6.2.** Let `K/k` be a field extension, `𝓘_K = d̃A_n(K) + x₁^N d̃A_n(K)`
and `Q_K = Q ⊗_k K = A_n(K)/𝓘_K` with the order filtration
`Q_{K,i} = qF_iA_n(K)`.  Then `gr Q_K ≅ gr Q ⊗_k K` (as `K`-modules; Lean writes the factor `K` on
the left, `K ⊗_k gr Q`),
`Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr Q_K = (Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q) K[x,ξ]`, and `Q = 0 ⇔ Q_K = 0`.
In particular, `Char(Q_K)` is the preimage of `Char(Q)` under
`Spec K[x,ξ] → Spec k[x,ξ]`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.lemma_6_2.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.lemma_6_2.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  Nonempty (grQ K N (dtK K dt) ≃ₗ[K] TensorProduct k K (grQ k N dt)) ∧
    Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt)) =
        Ideal.map (σ k K n)
          (Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt)) ∧
      (Subsingleton (Q k N dt) ↔ Subsingleton (Q K N (dtK K dt))) ∧
        Section2.Char K (idealI K N (dtK K dt)) =
          PrimeSpectrum.comap (σ k K n) ⁻¹' Section2.Char k (idealI k N dt)
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.lemma_6_2.source:
/-- **Lemma 6.2.** Let `K/k` be a field extension, `𝓘_K = d̃A_n(K) + x₁^N d̃A_n(K)`
and `Q_K = Q ⊗_k K = A_n(K)/𝓘_K` with the order filtration
`Q_{K,i} = qF_iA_n(K)`.  Then `gr Q_K ≅ gr Q ⊗_k K` (as `K`-modules; Lean writes the factor `K` on
the left, `K ⊗_k gr Q`),
`Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr Q_K = (Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q) K[x,ξ]`, and `Q = 0 ⇔ Q_K = 0`.
In particular, `Char(Q_K)` is the preimage of `Char(Q)` under
`Spec K[x,ξ] → Spec k[x,ξ]`. -/
theorem lemma_6_2 {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    Nonempty (grQ K N (dtK K dt) ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[k] grQ k N dt) ∧
      Module.annihilator (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt)) =
        (Module.annihilator (SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt)).map (σ k K n) ∧
      (Subsingleton (Q k N dt) ↔ Subsingleton (Q K N (dtK K dt))) ∧
      Section2.Char K (idealI K N (dtK K dt)) =
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (σ k K n) ⁻¹' Section2.Char k (idealI k N dt) :=
  ⟨⟨(step_6_2_graded (K := K) dt).symm⟩,
    step_6_2_annihilator dt, step_6_2_vanishing dt, step_6_2_char dt⟩

/-- `φ : A ⊕ A → T`, `φ(r, s) = t₁r + t₂s`. -/
def phi63 (t₁ t₂ : T) : (A × A) →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] T where
  toFun z := (MulOpposite.op z.1 : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₁ + (MulOpposite.op z.2 : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂
  map_add' z w := by
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, MulOpposite.op_add, add_smul]
    abel
  map_smul' c z := by
    simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop,
      MulOpposite.op_mul, MulOpposite.op_unop, smul_add, smul_smul, RingHom.id_apply]

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.stably_generat.doc:
Replacing `a_1` by `a_1 - a_{l+1}F` (`step_6_3_pair`) and keeping
`a_2, …, a_l`: with `1 = dR + FdS` for a common annihilator `d` of `a_1` and
`a_{l+1}`, the stable-generation property holds for every `l ≥ 1`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.stably_generat.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.stably_generated_of_identity.{u, v} {A : Type u} [Ring A] {T : Type v}
  [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T]
  (hOre : AlgebraicAnalysis.OreRightIntersection.RightOreCondition A)
  (hone : ∀ (d : A), d ≠ 0 → ∃ F R S, 1 = d * R + F * d * S) (htorsion : IsTorsion A T) :
  IsStablyGenerated A T 1
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.stably_generat.source:
/-- Replacing `a_1` by `a_1 - a_{l+1}F` (`step_6_3_pair`) and keeping
`a_2, …, a_l`: with `1 = dR + FdS` for a common annihilator `d` of `a_1` and
`a_{l+1}`, the stable-generation property holds for every `l ≥ 1`. -/
theorem stably_generated_of_identity (hOre : RightOreCondition A)
    (hone : ∀ d : A, d ≠ 0 → ∃ F R S : A, (1 : A) = d * R + F * d * S)
    (htorsion : Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsTorsion A T) : IsStablyGenerated A T 1 := by
  classical
  intro l hl a ha
  obtain ⟨d, hd, h₁, h₂⟩ := step_6_3_common_annihilator hOre htorsion (a 0) (a (Fin.last l))
  obtain ⟨F, R, S, hcert⟩ := hone d hd
  let i₀ : Fin l := ⟨0, hl⟩
  refine ⟨fun i => if i = i₀ then -F else 0, ?_⟩
  have hpair := step_6_3_pair (a 0) (a (Fin.last l)) d F R S h₁ h₂ hcert
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← ha, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  let U := Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range fun i : Fin l =>
    a i.castSucc + (MulOpposite.op (if i = i₀ then -F else 0) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a (Fin.last l))
  have hmem0 : a 0 - (MulOpposite.op F : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a (Fin.last l) ∈ U := by
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨i₀, ?_⟩
    simp only [↓reduceIte, MulOpposite.op_neg, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rfl
  have hpairU : Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ ({a 0, a (Fin.last l)} : Set T) ≤ U := by
    rw [← hpair, Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact hmem0
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst hj0
    exact hpairU (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
  by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last l
  · subst hjl
    exact hpairU (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hjl
    have hi : i ≠ i₀ := fun h => hj0 (by rw [h]; rfl)
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, ?_⟩
    simp [hi]

∀ {A : Type u} [inst : Ring A] {T : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup T] [inst_2 : Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T],
  AlgebraicAnalysis.OreRightIntersection.RightOreCondition A →
    (∀ (d : A), d ≠ 0 → ∃ F R S, 1 = d * R + F * d * S) →
      (∀ (m : T), ∃ d, d ≠ 0 ∧ MulOpposite.op d • m = 0) →
        ∀ l ≥ 1,
          ∀ (a : Fin (l + 1) → T),
            Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range a) = ⊤ →
              ∃ f,
                Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ
                    (Set.range fun i => a i.castSucc + MulOpposite.op (f i) • a (Fin.last l)) =
                  ⊤

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.stafford_1978_.doc:
**[Sta78, Thm. 3.7]** (right-module version), as cited in the proof of
Corollary 6.3: every finitely generated torsion right `A_n(k)`-module `T` is
generated by two elements, and is stably two-generated (for `l ≥ 2` and
generators `a_1, …, a_{l+1}` there are `f_i` with `a_i + a_{l+1}f_i`,
`i ≤ l`, generating `T`).  Proved here from Theorem 1.1, which does not use
Corollary 6.3: `two_generators_of_identity` and
`stably_generated_of_identity`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.stafford_1978_.source:
/-- **[Sta78, Thm. 3.7]** (right-module version), as cited in the proof of
Corollary 6.3: every finitely generated torsion right `A_n(k)`-module `T` is
generated by two elements, and is stably two-generated (for `l ≥ 2` and
generators `a_1, …, a_{l+1}` there are `f_i` with `a_i + a_{l+1}f_i`,
`i ≤ l`, generating `T`).  Proved here from Theorem 1.1, which does not use
Corollary 6.3: `two_generators_of_identity` and
`stably_generated_of_identity`. -/
theorem stafford_1978_theorem_3_7 (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
    (T : Type v) [AddCommGroup T] [Module (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ T]
    [Module.Finite (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ T]
    (hT : Section2.IsTorsion (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg k n) T) :
    (∃ t₁ t₂ : T, Submodule.span (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg k n)ᵐᵒᵖ ({t₁, t₂} : Set T) = ⊤) ∧
      IsStablyGenerated (Stafford38Challenge.WeylAlg k n) T 2 :=
  ⟨two_generators_of_identity (weyl_rightOreCondition (k := k) n)
      (fun d hd => Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1 k n d hd) hT,
    fun l hl => stably_generated_of_identity (weyl_rightOreCondition (k := k) n)
      (fun d hd => Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1 k n d hd) hT l (by omega)⟩

Since `M` is finitely generated, `Char(Q) = V(Ann M) = Supp(M)`
(Stacks 00L2).

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_1_char_.source:
/-- Since `M` is finitely generated, `Char(Q) = V(Ann M) = Supp(M)`
(Stacks 00L2). -/
theorem step_6_1_char_eq_support {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    Section2.Char k (idealI k N dt) = Module.support (SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt) := by
  have := step_6_1_finite (N := N) dt
  rw [Section2.Char_eq, Module.support_eq_zeroLocus]

/-- By Corollary 4.11, `M/x₁M = 0`, so `Supp(M) ∩ V(x₁) = ∅`. -/
theorem step_6_1_support_avoids [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) :
    Module.support (SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt) ∩ Vx₁ k n = ∅ := by

/-- Since `M` is finite, `Supp(M/x₁M) = Supp(M) ∩ V(x₁)` (Stacks 00L3). -/
theorem step_6_1_support_quotient {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_annih.doc:
**Lemma 6.2, proof, third sentence.** `gr Q` is finitely generated (cyclic,
generated by `q̄`) over `k[x, ξ]`, and `k[x, ξ] → K[x, ξ] = K ⊗_k k[x, ξ]` is flat,
so the annihilator commutes with the base change (Stacks 07T8): through
`gr Q_K ≅ K ⊗_k gr Q`, `Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr Q_K = (Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q) K[x,ξ]`.  (For the
cyclic module the 07T8 argument is spelled out: write `g ∈ K[x, ξ]` as
`∑ b_λ σ(f_λ)` for a `k`-basis `b` of `K`.)
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_annih.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_annihilator.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt)) =
    Ideal.map (σ k K n) (Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt))
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_annih.source:
/-- **Lemma 6.2, proof, third sentence.** `gr Q` is finitely generated (cyclic,
generated by `q̄`) over `k[x, ξ]`, and `k[x, ξ] → K[x, ξ] = K ⊗_k k[x, ξ]` is flat,
so the annihilator commutes with the base change (Stacks 07T8): through
`gr Q_K ≅ K ⊗_k gr Q`, `Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr Q_K = (Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q) K[x,ξ]`.  (For the
cyclic module the 07T8 argument is spelled out: write `g ∈ K[x, ξ]` as
`∑ b_λ σ(f_λ)` for a `k`-basis `b` of `K`.) -/
theorem step_6_2_annihilator (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    Module.annihilator (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt)) =
      (Module.annihilator (SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt)).map (σ k K n) := by
  classical
  let I := idealI k N dt
  let IK := idealI K N (dtK K dt)
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace k K
    let t := (MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k K).symm g
    let c := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b t
    have ht : t = c.sum fun l f => b l ⊗ₜ[k] f := by
      rw [← (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b).symm_apply_apply t]
      change (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b).symm.toLinearMap c = _
      rw [TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft_symm]
      simp [Finsupp.lsum_apply]
      rfl
    have hg' : g = c.sum fun l f => b l • σ k K n f := by
      rw [← (MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k K).apply_symm_apply g]
      change MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k K t = _
      rw [ht, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
      simp [Finsupp.sum, MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv_tmul]
    have hzero : step_6_2_graded (K := K) (N := N) dt (c.sum fun l f => b l ⊗ₜ[k] (f • qBar k I)) = 0 := by
      rw [Finsupp.sum, map_sum,
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => smul_qBar_K_eq (N := N) dt (b l) (c l),
        ← Finset.sum_smul]
      have := Module.mem_annihilator.mp hg (qBar K IK)
      rw [hg', Finsupp.sum] at this
      exact this
    rw [← map_zero (step_6_2_graded (K := K) (N := N) dt)] at hzero
    have hc := (step_6_2_graded (K := K) (N := N) dt).injective hzero
    have hmap : (c.mapRange (fun f => f • qBar k I) (zero_smul _ _)) = 0 := by
      apply TensorProduct.sum_tmul_basis_left_eq_zero b
      rw [Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (fun _ => TensorProduct.tmul_zero _ _)]
      exact hc
    have hann : ∀ l, c l ∈ Module.annihilator (SymbolRing k (n + 1)) (grQ k N dt) := by
      intro l
      have hl := congrArg (· l) hmap
      simp only [Finsupp.mapRange_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hl
      rw [Module.mem_annihilator]
      intro m
      obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := grCyclic_generated k I m
      rw [smul_comm, hl, smul_zero]
    rw [hg', Finsupp.sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ => ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hann l))
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro f hf
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Module.mem_annihilator]
    intro y
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (step_6_2_graded (K := K) (N := N) dt).surjective y
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, smul_zero]
    | tmul c m =>
        obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := grCyclic_generated k I m
        rw [smul_qBar_K_eq, smul_smul, mul_comm, ← smul_smul,
          ← step_6_2_graded_one_tmul_smul, Module.mem_annihilator.mp hf, TensorProduct.tmul_zero,
          map_zero, smul_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, smul_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

/-- `gr Q_K ≅ K ⊗_k gr Q` (as `K`-modules), assembled from the pieces through
`grCyclicEquiv`. -/
def step_6_2_graded (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    K ⊗[k] grQ k N dt ≃ₗ[K] grQ K N (dtK K dt) :=
  (LinearEquiv.baseChange k K _ _ (grCyclicEquiv k (idealI k N dt))).trans
    ((step_6_2_sum dt).trans (grCyclicEquiv K (idealI K N (dtK K dt))).symm)

/-- **Lemma 6.2, proof, second sentence.** As `K` is flat over `k`,
`Q_{K,i}/Q_{K,i-1} = (Q_i/Q_{i-1}) ⊗_k K`. -/
def step_6_2_graded_pieces (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) (i : ℕ) :
    K ⊗[k] grPiece (Qpiece k N dt) i ≃ₗ[K] grPiece (Qpiece K N (dtK K dt)) i :=
  tensorPieceEquiv (theta62 (N := N) dt) (Qpiece k N dt i) (lowerPiece (Qpiece k N dt) i)
    (by
      cases i with
      | zero => exact bot_le
      | succ i => exact (cyclicFiltration_order_isCompatible k _).mono (Nat.le_succ i))
    _ _ (step_6_2_pieces dt i) (lowerPiece_Qpiece_baseChange dt i)

theorem step_6_2_ideal {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    Submodule.map (pbwTensorEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (n + 1)).toLinearMap
        ((rightIdealKSubmodule k (idealI k N dt)).baseChange K) =
      rightIdealKSubmodule K (idealI K N (dtK K dt)) :=
  pbwTensorEquiv_map_canonicalRightIdeal n N dt

**Lemma 6.2, proof, first sentence.** By the PBW basis
`F_iA_n(K) = F_iA_n(k) ⊗_k K` and `𝓘_K = 𝓘 ⊗_k K`, so `Q_{K,i} = Q_i ⊗_k K`:
`θ` maps `K ⊗_k Q_i` onto `Q_{K,i} = qF_iA_n(K)`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_piece.source:
/-- **Lemma 6.2, proof, first sentence.** By the PBW basis
`F_iA_n(K) = F_iA_n(k) ⊗_k K` and `𝓘_K = 𝓘 ⊗_k K`, so `Q_{K,i} = Q_i ⊗_k K`:
`θ` maps `K ⊗_k Q_i` onto `Q_{K,i} = qF_iA_n(K)`. -/
theorem step_6_2_pieces (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) (i : ℕ) :
    ((Qpiece k N dt i).baseChange K).map (theta62 (N := N) dt).toLinearMap =
      Qpiece K N (dtK K dt) i := by
  set ι := presentedWeylScalarExtension (k := k) (K := K) (n + 1)
  set F := orderPiece k (n + 1) i
  have hF : orderPiece K (n + 1) i = Submodule.span K (ι '' F) := by
    rw [← pbwTensorEquiv_map_orderPiece (k := k) (K := K), Submodule.baseChange_eq_span,
      Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_coe, ← Set.image_comp]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Function.comp_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      pbwTensorEquiv_tmul_one, SetLike.mem_coe]
    rfl
  have hR : Qpiece K N (dtK K dt) i = Submodule.span K
      ((fun a => (Submodule.Quotient.mk (ι a) : Q K N (dtK K dt))) '' F) := by
    change (orderPiece K (n + 1) i).map (orbitMap (qClass K (idealI K N (dtK K dt)))) = _
    rw [hF, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Function.comp_apply, orbitMap_qClass]
  have hL : Qpiece k N dt i = Submodule.span k
      ((fun a => (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : Q k N dt)) '' F) := by
    calc Qpiece k N dt i = F.map (orbitMap (qClass k (idealI k N dt))) := rfl
      _ = (Submodule.span k (F : Set (PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)))).map
            (orbitMap (qClass k (idealI k N dt))) := by rw [Submodule.span_eq]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Submodule.map_span]
        congr 1
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_image, orbitMap_qClass]
  rw [hR, hL, Submodule.baseChange_span, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.image_comp, ← Set.image_comp]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [theta62_tmul, ι]

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_quoti.doc:
Consequently `Q ⊗_k K ≅ Q_K`: tensoring `0 → 𝓘 → A_n(k) → Q → 0` with
`K` and identifying the image of `𝓘 ⊗_k K` with `𝓘_K` by `step_6_2_ideal`.

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_quotient.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  TensorProduct k (Q k N dt) K ≃ₗ[k] Q K N (dtK K dt)
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_2_quoti.source:
/-- Consequently `Q ⊗_k K ≅ Q_K`: tensoring `0 → 𝓘 → A_n(k) → Q → 0` with
`K` and identifying the image of `𝓘 ⊗_k K` with `𝓘_K` by `step_6_2_ideal`. -/
def step_6_2_quotient {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    Q k N dt ⊗[k] K ≃ₗ[k] Q K N (dtK K dt) := by
  let J := rightIdealKSubmodule k (idealI k N dt)
  let eK := pbwTensorEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (n + 1)
  let JK := rightIdealKSubmodule K (idealI K N (dtK K dt))
  let f := (TensorProduct.comm k (PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) K).trans
    (LinearEquiv.restrictScalars k eK)
  let D := LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map J.subtype (LinearMap.id : K →ₗ[k] K))
  have hden : Submodule.map f.toLinearMap D = JK.restrictScalars k := by
    have hf : f.toLinearMap =
        (LinearEquiv.restrictScalars k eK).toLinearMap.comp
          (TensorProduct.comm k (PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) K).toLinearMap := by
      ext z
      rfl
    rw [hf, Submodule.map_comp,
      Stafford38.PaperQuotientDescent.comm_map_tensorSubmodule_range]
    calc
      Submodule.map (LinearEquiv.restrictScalars k eK).toLinearMap
        (Submodule.restrictScalars k (J.baseChange K)) =
        Submodule.restrictScalars k (Submodule.map eK.toLinearMap (J.baseChange K)) :=
          (Submodule.restrictScalars_map eK.toLinearMap (J.baseChange K)).symm
      _ = Submodule.restrictScalars k JK := by rw [step_6_2_ideal]
  exact (TensorProduct.congr (filteredRightQuotientEquivRightQuotient k (idealI k N dt)).symm
      (LinearEquiv.refl k K)).trans
    (((TensorProduct.quotientTensorEquiv K J).trans
      (Submodule.Quotient.equiv D (JK.restrictScalars k) f hden)).trans
    ((Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv k JK).trans
      (LinearEquiv.restrictScalars k
        (filteredRightQuotientEquivRightQuotient K (idealI K N (dtK K dt))))))

/-- Same sentence: summing over `i`, `gr Q_K = gr Q ⊗_k K` (Definition 2.3, `gr`). -/
def step_6_2_sum (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    K ⊗[k] gr (Qpiece k N dt) ≃ₗ[K] gr (Qpiece K N (dtK K dt)) :=
  (TensorProduct.directSumRight k K K (fun i => grPiece (Qpiece k N dt) i)).trans
    (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun i => step_6_2_graded_pieces dt i)

`Q = 0 ⇔ Q_K = 0`: `Q ⊗_k K = 0` implies `Q = 0` because `K` is a nonzero

/-- `Q = 0 ⇔ Q_K = 0`: `Q ⊗_k K = 0` implies `Q = 0` because `K` is a nonzero
free (so faithfully flat) `k`-module. -/
theorem step_6_2_vanishing {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    Subsingleton (Q k N dt) ↔ Subsingleton (Q K N (dtK K dt)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : Subsingleton (Q k N dt ⊗[k] K) := inferInstance
    exact (step_6_2_quotient (K := K) dt).toEquiv.symm.subsingleton
  · intro h
    have : Subsingleton (Q k N dt ⊗[k] K) := (step_6_2_quotient (K := K) dt).toEquiv.subsingleton
    exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.rTensor_reflects_triviality k K (Q k N dt)

              ∃ i j,
                a = FreeAlgebra.ι K i * FreeAlgebra.ι K j - FreeAlgebra.ι K j * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∧
                  b =
                    (algebraMap K (FreeAlgebra K (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                      (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) K i j))ᵐᵒᵖ
          {((RingQuot.liftAlgHom k)
                ⟨(FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>
                    (RingQuot.mkAlgHom K fun a b =>
                        ∃ i j,
                          a =
                              FreeAlgebra.ι K i * FreeAlgebra.ι K j -
                                FreeAlgebra.ι K j * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∧
                            b =
                              (algebraMap K (FreeAlgebra K (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) K i j))
                      (FreeAlgebra.ι K i),
                  ⋯⟩)
              dt,
            (RingQuot.mkAlgHom K fun a b =>
                    ∃ i j,
                      a =
                          FreeAlgebra.ι K i * FreeAlgebra.ι K j -
                            FreeAlgebra.ι K j * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∧
                        b =
                          (algebraMap K (FreeAlgebra K (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                            (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) K i j))
                  (FreeAlgebra.ι K (Sum.inl 0)) ^
                N *
              ((RingQuot.liftAlgHom k)
                  ⟨(FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>
                      (RingQuot.mkAlgHom K fun a b =>
                          ∃ i j,

                                  FreeAlgebra.ι K j * FreeAlgebra.ι K i ∧
                              b =

                                  (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) K i j))
                        (FreeAlgebra.ι K i),
                    ⋯⟩)
                dt})

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_commo.doc:
"`T` is torsion": `t₁d₁ = t₂d₂ = 0` with `d₁, d₂ ≠ 0`.  "`A_n` is a right
Ore domain": `d₁r₁ = d₂r₂ ≠ 0`, and `d := d₁r₁ = d₂r₂` is a common annihilator.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_commo.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_common_annihilator.{u, v} {A : Type u} [Ring A] {T : Type v}
  [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T]
  (hOre : AlgebraicAnalysis.OreRightIntersection.RightOreCondition A) (htorsion : IsTorsion A T)
  (t₁ t₂ : T) : ∃ d, d ≠ 0 ∧ MulOpposite.op d • t₁ = 0 ∧ MulOpposite.op d • t₂ = 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_commo.source:
/-- "`T` is torsion": `t₁d₁ = t₂d₂ = 0` with `d₁, d₂ ≠ 0`.  "`A_n` is a right
Ore domain": `d₁r₁ = d₂r₂ ≠ 0`, and `d := d₁r₁ = d₂r₂` is a common annihilator. -/
theorem step_6_3_common_annihilator (hOre : RightOreCondition A)
    (htorsion : Stafford38.Paper.Section2.IsTorsion A T) (t₁ t₂ : T) :
    ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₁ = 0 ∧
      (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂ = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁, h₁⟩ := htorsion t₁
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂, h₂⟩ := htorsion t₂
  obtain ⟨r₁, r₂, hr, hne⟩ := hOre hd₁ hd₂
  refine ⟨d₁ * r₁, hne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [MulOpposite.op_mul, mul_smul, h₁, smul_zero]
  · rw [hr, MulOpposite.op_mul, mul_smul, h₂, smul_zero]
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_commo.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u} [inst : Ring A] {T : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup T] [inst_2 : Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T],
  AlgebraicAnalysis.OreRightIntersection.RightOreCondition A →
    (∀ (m : T), ∃ d, d ≠ 0 ∧ MulOpposite.op d • m = 0) →
      ∀ (t₁ t₂ : T), ∃ d, d ≠ 0 ∧ MulOpposite.op d • t₁ = 0 ∧ MulOpposite.op d • t₂ = 0

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_gener.doc:
"`A_n ⊕ A_n` can be generated by `(a, 1 - Fa)` and `(1, -F)`":
`(x, y) = (a, 1 - Fa)u + (1, -F)v` with `u = y + Fx` and `v = x - a(y + Fx)`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_gener.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_generators.{u} {A : Type u} [Ring A] (a F : A) :
  (∀ (x y : A),
      (x, y) =
        MulOpposite.op (y + F * x) • (a, 1 - F * a) +
          MulOpposite.op (x - a * (y + F * x)) • (1, -F)) ∧
    Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {(a, 1 - F * a), (1, -F)} = ⊤
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_gener.source:
/-- "`A_n ⊕ A_n` can be generated by `(a, 1 - Fa)` and `(1, -F)`":
`(x, y) = (a, 1 - Fa)u + (1, -F)v` with `u = y + Fx` and `v = x - a(y + Fx)`. -/
theorem step_6_3_generators (a F : A) :
    (∀ x y : A, ((x, y) : A × A) =
      (MulOpposite.op (y + F * x) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • (a, 1 - F * a) +
        (MulOpposite.op (x - a * (y + F * x)) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • (1, -F)) ∧
      Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ ({(a, 1 - F * a), (1, -F)} : Set (A × A)) = ⊤ := by
  have hid : ∀ x y : A, ((x, y) : A × A) =
      (MulOpposite.op (y + F * x) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • (a, 1 - F * a) +
        (MulOpposite.op (x - a * (y + F * x)) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • (1, -F) := by
    intro x y
    simp only [Prod.smul_mk, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, MulOpposite.unop_op,
      Prod.mk_add_mk, one_mul, Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> noncomm_ring
  refine ⟨hid, top_unique ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ -
  rw [hid x y]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))
    (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_kerne.doc:
"`(d, 0)` and `(0, d)` are elements in `M = ker φ`", hence
`(d, 0)S + (0, d)R = (dS, dR) = (dS, 1 - FdS) =: (a, 1 - Fa) ∈ M`; and
`φ(1, -F) = t₁ - t₂F`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_kerne.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_kernel.{u, v} {A : Type u} [Ring A] {T : Type v} [AddCommGroup T]
  [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] (t₁ t₂ : T) (d F R S : A) (h₁ : MulOpposite.op d • t₁ = 0)
  (h₂ : MulOpposite.op d • t₂ = 0) (hcert : 1 = d * R + F * d * S) :
  (d, 0) ∈ (phi63 t₁ t₂).ker ∧
    (0, d) ∈ (phi63 t₁ t₂).ker ∧
      MulOpposite.op S • (d, 0) + MulOpposite.op R • (0, d) = (d * S, 1 - F * (d * S)) ∧
        (d * S, 1 - F * (d * S)) ∈ (phi63 t₁ t₂).ker ∧
          (phi63 t₁ t₂) (1, -F) = t₁ - MulOpposite.op F • t₂
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_kerne.source:
/-- "`(d, 0)` and `(0, d)` are elements in `M = ker φ`", hence
`(d, 0)S + (0, d)R = (dS, dR) = (dS, 1 - FdS) =: (a, 1 - Fa) ∈ M`; and
`φ(1, -F) = t₁ - t₂F`. -/
theorem step_6_3_kernel (t₁ t₂ : T) (d F R S : A)
    (h₁ : (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₁ = 0) (h₂ : (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂ = 0)
    (hcert : (1 : A) = d * R + F * d * S) :
    ((d, 0) : A × A) ∈ LinearMap.ker (phi63 t₁ t₂) ∧
      ((0, d) : A × A) ∈ LinearMap.ker (phi63 t₁ t₂) ∧
      (MulOpposite.op S : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • ((d, 0) : A × A) + (MulOpposite.op R : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • (0, d) =
        (d * S, 1 - F * (d * S)) ∧
      ((d * S, 1 - F * (d * S)) : A × A) ∈ LinearMap.ker (phi63 t₁ t₂) ∧
      phi63 t₁ t₂ (1, -F) = t₁ - (MulOpposite.op F : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂ := by
  have hd0 : ((d, 0) : A × A) ∈ LinearMap.ker (phi63 t₁ t₂) := by
    change (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₁ + (MulOpposite.op (0 : A) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂ = 0
    rw [h₁, MulOpposite.op_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have h0d : ((0, d) : A × A) ∈ LinearMap.ker (phi63 t₁ t₂) := by
    change (MulOpposite.op (0 : A) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₁ + (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂ = 0
    rw [h₂, MulOpposite.op_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hcomb : (MulOpposite.op S : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • ((d, 0) : A × A) +
      (MulOpposite.op R : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • (0, d) = (d * S, 1 - F * (d * S)) := by
    simp only [Prod.smul_mk, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, MulOpposite.unop_op, zero_mul,
      Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
    rw [hcert]
    noncomm_ring
  refine ⟨hd0, h0d, hcomb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hcomb]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hd0) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h0d)
  · change (MulOpposite.op (1 : A) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₁ + (MulOpposite.op (-F) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂ = _
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_kerne.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u} [inst : Ring A] {T : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup T] [inst_2 : Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T]
  (t₁ t₂ : T) (d F R S : A),
  MulOpposite.op d • t₁ = 0 →
    MulOpposite.op d • t₂ = 0 →
      1 = d * R + F * d * S →
        (d, 0) ∈
            { toFun := fun z => MulOpposite.op z.1 • t₁ + MulOpposite.op z.2 • t₂, map_add' := ⋯,
                map_smul' := ⋯ }.ker ∧
          (0, d) ∈
              { toFun := fun z => MulOpposite.op z.1 • t₁ + MulOpposite.op z.2 • t₂, map_add' := ⋯,
                  map_smul' := ⋯ }.ker ∧
            MulOpposite.op S • (d, 0) + MulOpposite.op R • (0, d) = (d * S, 1 - F * (d * S)) ∧
              (d * S, 1 - F * (d * S)) ∈
                  { toFun := fun z => MulOpposite.op z.1 • t₁ + MulOpposite.op z.2 • t₂,
                      map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }.ker ∧
                { toFun := fun z => MulOpposite.op z.1 • t₁ + MulOpposite.op z.2 • t₂,
                      map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ }
                    (1, -F) =
                  t₁ - MulOpposite.op F • t₂

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_pair.doc:
"Since `A_n ⊕ A_n` can be generated by `(a, 1 - Fa)` and `(1, -F)` and
`(a, 1 - Fa) ∈ M`, `T ≅ (A_n ⊕ A_n)/M` can be generated by
`φ(1, -F) = t₁ - t₂F`": the image `t₁A + t₂A` of `φ` is generated by
`t₁ - t₂F`.  (For `l = 1` this is also the stable-cyclicity statement with
`f₁ = -F`.)
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_pair.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_pair.{u, v} {A : Type u} [Ring A] {T : Type v} [AddCommGroup T]
  [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] (t₁ t₂ : T) (d F R S : A) (h₁ : MulOpposite.op d • t₁ = 0)
  (h₂ : MulOpposite.op d • t₂ = 0) (hcert : 1 = d * R + F * d * S) :
  Aᵐᵒᵖ ∙ (t₁ - MulOpposite.op F • t₂) = Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {t₁, t₂}
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_pair.source:
/-- "Since `A_n ⊕ A_n` can be generated by `(a, 1 - Fa)` and `(1, -F)` and
`(a, 1 - Fa) ∈ M`, `T ≅ (A_n ⊕ A_n)/M` can be generated by
`φ(1, -F) = t₁ - t₂F`": the image `t₁A + t₂A` of `φ` is generated by
`t₁ - t₂F`.  (For `l = 1` this is also the stable-cyclicity statement with
`f₁ = -F`.) -/
theorem step_6_3_pair (t₁ t₂ : T) (d F R S : A)
    (h₁ : (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₁ = 0) (h₂ : (MulOpposite.op d : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂ = 0)
    (hcert : (1 : A) = d * R + F * d * S) :
    Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ ({t₁ - (MulOpposite.op F : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • t₂} : Set T) =
      Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ ({t₁, t₂} : Set T) := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hzero, hgen⟩ := step_6_3_kernel t₁ t₂ d F R S h₁ h₂ hcert
  rw [← step_6_3_phi_range, ← Submodule.map_top, ← (step_6_3_generators (d * S) F).2,
    Submodule.map_span, Set.image_pair, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hzero, hgen]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Submodule.span_mono (by simp)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl
    · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · exact Submodule.subset_span rfl

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_phi_r.doc:
"This map is surjective, since `t₁, t₂` generate all of `T`": the image of
`φ` is `t₁A + t₂A`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_phi_r.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_phi_range.{u, v} {A : Type u} [Ring A] {T : Type v}
  [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] (t₁ t₂ : T) : (phi63 t₁ t₂).range = Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {t₁, t₂}
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_phi_r.source:
/-- "This map is surjective, since `t₁, t₂` generate all of `T`": the image of
`φ` is `t₁A + t₂A`. -/
theorem step_6_3_phi_range (t₁ t₂ : T) :
    LinearMap.range (phi63 (A := A) t₁ t₂) = Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ ({t₁, t₂} : Set T) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro z ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨(1, 0), by simp [phi63]⟩
    · exact ⟨(0, 1), by simp [phi63]⟩
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_6_3_phi_r.unfolded:
∀ {A : Type u} [inst : Ring A] {T : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup T] [inst_2 : Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T]
  (t₁ t₂ : T),
  { toFun := fun z => MulOpposite.op z.1 • t₁ + MulOpposite.op z.2 • t₂, map_add' := ⋯,
        map_smul' := ⋯ }.range =
    Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {t₁, t₂}

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_QK_zero.doc:
"Since the filtration of `Q_K` is exhaustive with `Q_{K,-1} = 0`,
induction on `m` implies `Q_{K,m} = 0` for all `m`, so `Q_K = 0`": `gr Q_K` is
the associated graded module of `Q_{K,m} = qF_mA_n(K)` (`grCyclicEquiv`).
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_QK_zero.source:
/-- "Since the filtration of `Q_K` is exhaustive with `Q_{K,-1} = 0`,
induction on `m` implies `Q_{K,m} = 0` for all `m`, so `Q_K = 0`": `gr Q_K` is
the associated graded module of `Q_{K,m} = qF_mA_n(K)` (`grCyclicEquiv`). -/
theorem step_QK_zero {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (h : Subsingleton (grQ K N (dtK K dt))) :
    Subsingleton (Q K N (dtK K dt)) :=
  step_filtration_zero _ (cyclicFiltration_order_isCompatible K _).exhaustive
    ((grCyclicEquiv K (idealI K N (dtK K dt))).toEquiv.symm.subsingleton)

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_Vx₁_preim.doc: `V(x₁) ⊆ Spec K[x,ξ]` is the preimage of `V(x₁) ⊆ Spec k[x,ξ]`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_Vx₁_preim.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_Vx₁_preimage.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]

/-- `V(x₁) ⊆ Spec K[x,ξ]` is the preimage of `V(x₁) ⊆ Spec k[x,ξ]`. -/
theorem step_Vx₁_preimage {n : ℕ} :
    Vx₁ K n = PrimeSpectrum.comap (σ k K n) ⁻¹' Vx₁ k n := by
  ext p
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Vx₁, mem_V_iff, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem,

  change _ ↔ MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) (MvPolynomial.X _) ∈ p.asIdeal

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_P_axis.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
