Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_P_axis.source:
/-- **Bullet 5.** By (3.4) (Lemma 3.5), `P(1, 0, …, 0) = 1 ≠ 0`. -/
theorem step_W_P_axis {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N)
    {P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k} (hP : orderSymbol k N dt = MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr P) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => if i = ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩ then (1 : K) else 0)
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) P) = 1 := by
  have h := lemma_3_5_eval_axis k hform hdeg
  rw [hP, MvPolynomial.eval_rename] at h
  have hpt : (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => if i = ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩ then (1 : K) else 0) =
      algebraMap k K ∘ (axisPoint k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1))) ∘ Sum.inr) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0 <;> simp [axisPoint, hi]
  have hcomp := MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp_left (algebraMap k K) (RingHom.id k)
    (axisPoint k (.inr (0 : Fin (n + 1))) ∘ Sum.inr) P
  rw [RingHom.comp_id] at hcomp
  rw [hpt, MvPolynomial.eval_map, ← hcomp]
  change algebraMap k K (MvPolynomial.eval _ P) = 1
  rw [h, map_one]

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_P_vanis.doc:
**Bullet 4.** By (3.5) (Proposition 3.6), `P ∈ Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q`, hence
`P ∈ Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr Q_K` by Lemma 6.2, so `P` vanishes on `W`.  Here
`σ_N^ord(d̃) = P(ξ)` with `P ∈ k[ξ]` (Lemma 3.5), regarded in `K[ξ]`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_P_vanis.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_P_vanishes.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] {n N : ℕ} {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
  (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N)
  {P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k} (hP : orderSymbol k N dt = (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr) P)
  (q : Characteristic.PhaseVar (n + 1) → K) :
  q ∈ W K N dt →
    (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => q (Sum.inr i)) ((MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)) P) = 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_P_vanis.source:
/-- **Bullet 4.** By (3.5) (Proposition 3.6), `P ∈ Ann_{k[x,ξ]} gr Q`, hence
`P ∈ Ann_{K[x,ξ]} gr Q_K` by Lemma 6.2, so `P` vanishes on `W`.  Here
`σ_N^ord(d̃) = P(ξ)` with `P ∈ k[ξ]` (Lemma 3.5), regarded in `K[ξ]`. -/
theorem step_W_P_vanishes {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N)
    {P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k} (hP : orderSymbol k N dt = MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr P) :
    ∀ q ∈ W K N dt, MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => q (.inr i))
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) P) = 0 := by
  intro q hq
  have hAnn := proposition_3_6 k hform hdeg
  have hAnnK : σ k K n (orderSymbol k N dt) ∈
      Module.annihilator (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt)) := by
    rw [(lemma_6_2 (K := K) (N := N) dt).2.1]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hAnn
  have h := hq _ hAnnK
  rw [hP, σ, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, symbolScalarExtension_apply,
    MvPolynomial.map_rename, MvPolynomial.eval_rename] at h
  exact h

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_avoids_.doc:
**Bullet 6.** The closed points of `Char(Q_K) ∩ V(x₁)` are
`W ∩ π⁻¹(H)`, hence `W ∩ π⁻¹(H) = ∅` (`π = proj`, Definition 2.5).
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_avoids_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_avoids_H.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ}
  {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hN : 0 < N)
  (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) : W K N dt ∩ proj ⁻¹' {y | y ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0} = ∅
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_avoids_.source:
/-- **Bullet 6.** The closed points of `Char(Q_K) ∩ V(x₁)` are
`W ∩ π⁻¹(H)`, hence `W ∩ π⁻¹(H) = ∅` (`π = proj`, Definition 2.5). -/
theorem step_W_avoids_H [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) :
    W K N dt ∩ proj ⁻¹' {y : Fin (n + 1) → K | y ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩ = 0} = ∅ := by
  ext q
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
    iff_false]
  rintro ⟨hqW, hq1⟩
  have hmem : closedPoint K q ∈ Section2.Char K (idealI K N (dtK K dt)) ∩ Vx₁ K n :=
    ⟨((step_W_closed_points (K := K) (N := N) dt).1 q).1 hqW,
      (step_closedPoint_mem_Vx₁ q).2 hq1⟩
  rw [step_char_K_avoids hN hform] at hmem
  exact hmem

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed.doc: **Bullet 1.** `W` is Zariski closed, the zero set of an ideal.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  ∃ L, W K N dt = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K L
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed.source:
/-- **Bullet 1.** `W` is Zariski closed, the zero set of an ideal. -/
theorem step_W_closed {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    ∃ L : Ideal (SymbolRing K (n + 1)), W K N dt = MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K L :=
  ⟨_, VK_eq_zeroLocus K _⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed_.doc:
`W` is the set of closed points of `Char(Q_K)` (Theorem 2.12(a)), with
vanishing ideal `I(W) = √(Ann gr Q_K)` (Theorem 2.12(c)).
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed_.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed_points.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  (∀ (q : Characteristic.PhaseVar (n + 1) → K),
      q ∈ W K N dt ↔ closedPoint K q ∈ Section2.Char K (idealI K N (dtK K dt))) ∧
    vanishingIdealOf K (W K N dt) =
      (Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt))).radical
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_closed_.source:
/-- `W` is the set of closed points of `Char(Q_K)` (Theorem 2.12(a)), with
vanishing ideal `I(W) = √(Ann gr Q_K)` (Theorem 2.12(c)). -/
theorem step_W_closed_points [IsAlgClosed K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    (∀ q, q ∈ W K N dt ↔ closedPoint K q ∈ Section2.Char K (idealI K N (dtK K dt))) ∧
      vanishingIdealOf K (W K N dt) =
        (Module.annihilator (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt))).radical :=
  ⟨fun q => by rw [Section2.Char_eq]; exact (theorem_2_12 K _).1.2.2 q, (theorem_2_12 K _).2.2⟩

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_empty.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_empty.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ}
  {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hN : 0 < N)
  (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) : W K N dt = ∅
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_empty.source:
/-- **Theorem 5.8 applies:** `W = ∅`. -/
theorem step_W_empty [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ}
    {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)} (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt)
    (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
    W K N dt = ∅ := by
  obtain ⟨-, P, hP, -⟩ := lemma_3_5 k hform hdeg
  have hinv : Stafford38.Characteristic.PostScalarExtensionPoisson.IsInvolutive
      (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal K (W K N dt)) :=
    (isInvolutive_iff K _).1 (step_W_involutive (K := K) (N := N) dt)
  exact Stafford38.Paper.Section5.theorem_5_8 (Nat.succ_pos n) (W K N dt)
    (step_W_closed dt) (step_W_fibreConical dt) hinv
    (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) P)
    (by rw [step_W_P_axis hform hdeg hP]; exact one_ne_zero)
    (step_W_P_vanishes hform hdeg hP) (step_W_avoids_H hN hform)

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_fibreCo.doc:
**Bullet 2.** `W` is fibre-conical: for `g ∈ Ann gr Q_K` and `(y, ξ) ∈ W`,
`g(y, tξ) = ∑_d t^d g_d(y, ξ) = 0`, as every `ξ`-homogeneous component `g_d`
lies in `Ann gr Q_K`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_fibreCo.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_fibreConical.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] {n N : ℕ}
  (dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  Geometry.FibreConicalVanishingIdeal.IsFibreConical (W K N dt)
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_fibreCo.source:
/-- **Bullet 2.** `W` is fibre-conical: for `g ∈ Ann gr Q_K` and `(y, ξ) ∈ W`,
`g(y, tξ) = ∑_d t^d g_d(y, ξ) = 0`, as every `ξ`-homogeneous component `g_d`
lies in `Ann gr Q_K`. -/
theorem step_W_fibreConical [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    IsFibreConical (W K N dt) := by
  have hhom := step_annihilator_homogeneous (K := K) (N := N) dt
  rw [W, VK_eq_zeroLocus]
  intro q hq a _
  let y : Fin (n + 1) → K := fun i => q (.inl i)
  let ξ : Fin (n + 1) → K := fun i => q (.inr i)
  have hqsplit : q = Sum.elim y ξ := by
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> rfl
  have hline (f : SymbolRing K (n + 1))
      (hf : f ∈ Module.annihilator (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt))) :
      fibreLinePolynomial y ξ f = 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.ext
    intro d
    rw [coeff_fibreLinePolynomial_eq_eval_weightedHomogeneousComponent, ← hqsplit]
    exact (MvPolynomial.mem_zeroLocus_iff.mp hq) _ (hhom d hf)
  intro f hf
  have heval := eval_fibreLinePolynomial y ξ f a
  rw [hline f hf, Polynomial.eval_zero] at heval
  simpa [y, ξ] using heval.symm

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_involut.doc:
**Bullet 3.** `I(W)` is involutive, by Gabber's theorem (Theorem 2.11)
and `I(W) = √(Ann gr Q_K)`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_W_involut.source:
/-- **Bullet 3.** `I(W)` is involutive, by Gabber's theorem (Theorem 2.11)
and `I(W) = √(Ann gr Q_K)`. -/
theorem step_W_involutive [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] {n N : ℕ}
    (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    IsInvolutiveSet K (W K N dt) := by
  rw [IsInvolutiveSet, (step_W_closed_points (K := K) (N := N) dt).2]
  exact theorem_2_11_cyclic K (n + 1) (idealI K N (dtK K dt))

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_annihilat.doc:
"The module `gr Q_K` is graded by the order filtration, which assigns
degree `0` to the `x_i` and degree `1` to the `ξ_i`; so `Ann gr Q_K` is
homogeneous in `ξ`": a homogeneous `g_d` of degree `d` maps the degree-`0`
generator `q̄` into degree `d`, so `g q̄ = 0` forces `g_d q̄ = 0` for every
component, and `gr Q_K` is generated by `q̄`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_annihilat.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_annihilator_homogeneous.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k]
  [Field K] [Algebra k K] {n N : ℕ} (dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
  Ideal.IsHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule K WeylFiltration.orderWeight)
    (Module.annihilator (Characteristic.SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt)))
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_annihilat.source:
/-- "The module `gr Q_K` is graded by the order filtration, which assigns
degree `0` to the `x_i` and degree `1` to the `ξ_i`; so `Ann gr Q_K` is
homogeneous in `ξ`": a homogeneous `g_d` of degree `d` maps the degree-`0`
generator `q̄` into degree `d`, so `g q̄ = 0` forces `g_d q̄ = 0` for every
component, and `gr Q_K` is generated by `q̄`. -/
theorem step_annihilator_homogeneous {n N : ℕ} (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) :
    (Module.annihilator (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (grQ K N (dtK K dt))).IsHomogeneous
      (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule K (@orderWeight (n + 1))) := by
  classical
  let I := idealI K N (dtK K dt)
  let 𝒜 := MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule K (@orderWeight (n + 1))
  let x0 := orderPieceToQuotientGraded K I 0 (orderPieceOne (n := n + 1) K)
  have hq : qBar K I = orderAssociatedGradedOf K I 0 x0 := rfl
  -- `π_e`, the degree-`e` component of `gr Q_K = ⊕_e Q_{K,e}/Q_{K,e-1}`.
  let π : ∀ e : ℕ, OrderAssociatedGradedModule K I →+ QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I e :=
    fun e => { toFun := fun z =>
                (show Stafford38.CharacteristicFilteredQuotientGraded.QuotientOrderAssociatedGraded
                  K I from z) e
               map_zero' := rfl
               map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  have hπ : ∀ e j (x : QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I j),
      π e (orderAssociatedGradedOf K I j x) = if h : j = e then h ▸ x else 0 := by
    intro e j x
    change (DirectSum.of _ j x : DirectSum ℕ _) e = _
    rw [DirectSum.of_apply]
  -- The degree-`(0 + d)` component of `g q̄` is `g_d q̄`.
  have hcomp : ∀ (g : SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (d : ℕ),
      ((DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 g d : SymbolRing K (n + 1))) • qBar K I =
        orderAssociatedGradedOf K I (0 + d) (π (0 + d) (g • qBar K I)) := by
    intro g d
    rw [hq, smul_orderAssociatedGradedOf_eq_of_homogeneousAction]
    congr 1
    conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 g]
    rw [Finset.sum_smul, map_sum]
    simp_rw [smul_orderAssociatedGradedOf_eq_of_homogeneousAction, hπ]
    by_cases hd : d ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 g).support
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single d]
      · simp
      · intro i _ hid
        exact dite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => absurd h (by omega)
      · exact fun h => absurd hd h
    · have hact : CharacteristicFilteredQuotientGraded.quotientOrderHomogeneousAction K I
          (0 : 𝒜 d) x0 = 0 := by
        have h0 := smul_orderAssociatedGradedOf_eq_of_homogeneousAction K I (0 : 𝒜 d) x0
        rw [Submodule.coe_zero, zero_smul] at h0
        exact DirectSum.of_injective (β := QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I) (0 + d)
          (h0.symm.trans (map_zero (DirectSum.of (QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I) (0 + d))).symm)
      rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hd, hact, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      intro i hi
      exact dite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => absurd (show i = d by omega ▸ hi) hd
  intro d g hg
  rw [Module.mem_annihilator] at hg ⊢
  intro m
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := grCyclic_generated K I m
  rw [smul_comm, hcomp, hg, map_zero]
  have h0 : orderAssociatedGradedOf K I (0 + d) 0 = (0 : OrderAssociatedGradedModule K I) :=
    map_zero _
  rw [h0]
  exact smul_zero h

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_char_K_av.doc:
**Bullet 6, first part.** `Char(Q_K)` and `V(x₁)` are the preimages of
`Char(Q)` and `V(x₁)` under `Spec K[x,ξ] → Spec k[x,ξ]` (Lemma 6.2), and
preimages commute with intersections, so Proposition 6.1 gives
`Char(Q_K) ∩ V(x₁) = ∅`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_char_K_av.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_char_K_avoids.{u, v} {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K]
  [Algebra k K] [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ} {dt : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
  (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) :
  Section2.Char K (idealI K N (dtK K dt)) ∩ Vx₁ K n = ∅
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_char_K_av.source:
/-- **Bullet 6, first part.** `Char(Q_K)` and `V(x₁)` are the preimages of
`Char(Q)` and `V(x₁)` under `Spec K[x,ξ] → Spec k[x,ξ]` (Lemma 6.2), and
preimages commute with intersections, so Proposition 6.1 gives
`Char(Q_K) ∩ V(x₁) = ∅`. -/
theorem step_char_K_avoids [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) :
    Section2.Char K (idealI K N (dtK K dt)) ∩ Vx₁ K n = ∅ := by
  rw [(lemma_6_2 (K := K) (N := N) dt).2.2.2, step_Vx₁_preimage (k := k), ← Set.preimage_inter,
    proposition_6_1 hN hform, Set.preimage_empty]

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_closedPoi.doc:
**Bullet 6, second part.** By Definition 2.6 a closed point
`𝔪_{(y,ξ)}` lies in `V(x₁)` iff `y₁ = 0`, so the closed points of `V(x₁)` form
`π⁻¹(H) = H × (K^n)^*`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_closedPoi.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_closedPoint_mem_Vx₁.{v} {K : Type v} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
  (q : Characteristic.PhaseVar (n + 1) → K) : closedPoint K q ∈ Vx₁ K n ↔ q (Sum.inl 0) = 0
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_closedPoi.source:
/-- **Bullet 6, second part.** By Definition 2.6 a closed point
`𝔪_{(y,ξ)}` lies in `V(x₁)` iff `y₁ = 0`, so the closed points of `V(x₁)` form
`π⁻¹(H) = H × (K^n)^*`. -/
theorem step_closedPoint_mem_Vx₁ {n : ℕ} (q : PhaseVar (n + 1) → K) :
    closedPoint K q ∈ Vx₁ K n ↔ q (.inl (0 : Fin (n + 1))) = 0 := by
  rw [Vx₁, mem_V_iff, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  change x₁Symbol K n ∈ maxIdealAt K q ↔ _
  rw [mem_maxIdealAt_iff, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_closedPoi.unfolded:
∀ {K : Type v} [inst : Field K] {n : ℕ} (q : Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1) → K),
  { asIdeal := Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.C (q i)),
        isPrime := ⋯ } ∈
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ↑(Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl 0)}) ↔
    q (Sum.inl 0) = 0

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_filtratio.doc:
An exhaustive filtration `M_0 ⊆ M_1 ⊆ …` with `M_{-1} = 0` and
`gr M = ⊕_m M_m/M_{m-1} = 0` has `M = 0`: by induction on `m`, `M_m = M_{m-1} = 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_filtratio.source:
/-- An exhaustive filtration `M_0 ⊆ M_1 ⊆ …` with `M_{-1} = 0` and
`gr M = ⊕_m M_m/M_{m-1} = 0` has `M = 0`: by induction on `m`, `M_m = M_{m-1} = 0`. -/
theorem step_filtration_zero {F : Type v} [Field F] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module F M]
    (Mf : ℕ → Submodule F M) (hex : ∀ x : M, ∃ i, x ∈ Mf i)
    (hgr : Subsingleton (Section2.gr Mf)) : Subsingleton M := by
  classical
  have hpiece : ∀ m (x : Mf m), x ∈ (lowerPiece Mf m).comap (Mf m).subtype := fun m x => by
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    apply DirectSum.of_injective (β := grPiece Mf) m
    rw [map_zero]
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hzero : ∀ m, Mf m = ⊥ := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        rw [eq_bot_iff]
        intro x hx
        simpa [lowerPiece] using hpiece 0 ⟨x, hx⟩
    | succ m ih =>
        rw [eq_bot_iff]
        intro x hx
        have h := hpiece (m + 1) ⟨x, hx⟩
        change x ∈ Mf m at h
        rw [ih] at h
        exact h
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex a
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hex b
  rw [hzero, Submodule.mem_bot] at hi hj
  rw [hi, hj]
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_filtratio.unfolded:
∀ {F : Type v} [inst : Field F] {M : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module F M]
  (Mf : ℕ → Submodule F M),
  (∀ (x : M), ∃ i, x ∈ Mf i) →
    Subsingleton
        (DirectSum ℕ fun j =>
          ↥(Mf j) ⧸ Submodule.comap (Mf j).subtype (Nat.casesOn j ⊥ fun n => Mf n)) →
      Subsingleton M

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_grQK_zero.doc:
As `K` is algebraically closed, `W = ∅` gives `1 ∈ Ann gr Q_K`
(Theorem 2.12(b)), so `gr Q_K = 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_grQK_zero.source:
/-- As `K` is algebraically closed, `W = ∅` gives `1 ∈ Ann gr Q_K`
(Theorem 2.12(b)), so `gr Q_K = 0`. -/
theorem step_grQK_zero [IsAlgClosed K] {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hW : W K N dt = ∅) :
    Subsingleton (grQ K N (dtK K dt)) := by
  have h1 := (theorem_2_12 K _).2.1.1 hW
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
  rw [← one_smul (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) a, ← one_smul (SymbolRing K (n + 1)) b,
    Module.mem_annihilator.mp h1, Module.mem_annihilator.mp h1]

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_rank_zero.doc: `n = 0`: `A_0(k) = k`, and every nonzero `d` is a unit.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_rank_zero.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_rank_zero.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k]
  (d : WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) : ∃ F R S, 1 = d * R + F * d * S
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.step_rank_zero.source:
/-- `n = 0`: `A_0(k) = k`, and every nonzero `d` is a unit. -/
theorem step_rank_zero (d : PresentedWeyl k 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ F R S : PresentedWeyl k 0, (1 : PresentedWeyl k 0) = d * R + F * d * S := by
  let e := presentedIteratedEquiv k 0
  let c : k := e d
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hczero
    change e d = 0 at hczero
    apply hd
    calc
      d = e.symm (e d) := (e.symm_apply_apply d).symm
      _ = e.symm 0 := congrArg e.symm hczero
      _ = 0 := map_zero e.symm
  refine ⟨0, e.symm (c⁻¹ : k), 0, ?_⟩
  have hmul : c * c⁻¹ = (1 : k) := mul_inv_cancel₀ hc
  have h : d * e.symm (c⁻¹ : k) = 1 := by
    calc d * e.symm (c⁻¹ : k)
        = e.symm c * e.symm (c⁻¹ : k) := by
          congr 1
          exact (e.symm_apply_apply d).symm
      _ = e.symm (c * c⁻¹) := (map_mul e.symm _ _).symm
      _ = e.symm 1 := congrArg e.symm hmul
      _ = 1 := map_one e.symm
  simpa using h.symm

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.theorem_1_1_fi.source:
/-- **Theorem 1.1, "moreover".** For `n ≥ 1` one may take
`F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^{deg_B d}` with a linear `ω`-preserving `g`; for
`deg_B d = 0` any linear coordinate works, since then `F = 1`. -/
theorem theorem_1_1_fixedSource_paper :
    Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.UniversalFixedSourceStatement.{u} := by
  intro k _ _ n d hd
  rw [← bernsteinDegree_eq]
  rcases section_3_reduction k hd with ⟨hN0, -⟩ | ⟨hN, g, c, -, hform, hdeg, himp⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, -, -, hcert⟩ := step_scalar_case k hd hN0
    refine ⟨_, algebraMap k _ c⁻¹, 0, phiG_symm_x₁_isLinearWeylCoordinate k 1, ?_⟩
    rw [hN0, pow_zero]
    exact hcert
  · exact himp (theorem_6_Q_eq_zero hN hform hdeg)

∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>

    ∃ ell R S,
      (∃ M N,
          ∃ (_ : M * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * M.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ :
            N * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * N.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ : M * N = 1)
            (_ : N * M = 1),
            ell =
              ∑ j,
                (algebraMap k
                      (RingQuot fun a b =>
                        ∃ i j,
                          a =
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                            b =
                              (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)))
                    (N (Sum.inl 0) j) *
                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                      ∃ i j,
                        a =
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧

                              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                    (FreeAlgebra.ι k j)) ∧
        1 =
          d * R +
            ell ^
                  sInf
                    {N |
                      d ∈
                        Submodule.span k
                          {z |
                            ∃ a p,
                              ∑ i, a i + ∑ i, p i ≤ N ∧
                                z =
                                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                                      ∃ i j,
                                        a =
                                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                                          b =
                                            (algebraMap k
                                                (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                                    (Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x =>
                                      (Fin x → ℕ) → (Fin x → ℕ) → FreeAlgebra k (Fin x ⊕ Fin x))
                                      (n + 1)
                                      (fun x f x_1 x_2 =>
                                        Nat.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
                                          (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                            (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                              Nat.below (motive := fun x =>
                                                  (Fin x → ℕ) →

                                                  x →

                                          x (fun x x_3 x_4 => 1)
                                          (fun n x x_3 x_4 =>
                                            ((FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>

                                              FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr 0) ^ x_3 0)
                                          x_1 x_2 f)
                                      a p)}} *

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.theorem_1_1_pa.doc:
**Proof of Theorem 1.1.**  `n = 0` is `step_rank_zero`.  For `n ≥ 1`,
Section 3 (`section_3_reduction`) either finds `deg_B d = 0` and a unit, or
the normal form `d̃ = c⁻¹Φ_g(d)` with `N = deg_B d ≥ 1`, for which `Q = 0`
(`theorem_6_Q_eq_zero`) gives `1 = d̃R + x₁^N d̃S` and, transported by
`Φ_g^{-1}` (Remark 3.3),
`1 = d(c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(R)) + F d(c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(S))` with `F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^N`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.theorem_1_1_pa.source:
/-- **Proof of Theorem 1.1.**  `n = 0` is `step_rank_zero`.  For `n ≥ 1`,
Section 3 (`section_3_reduction`) either finds `deg_B d = 0` and a unit, or
the normal form `d̃ = c⁻¹Φ_g(d)` with `N = deg_B d ≥ 1`, for which `Q = 0`
(`theorem_6_Q_eq_zero`) gives `1 = d̃R + x₁^N d̃S` and, transported by
`Φ_g^{-1}` (Remark 3.3),
`1 = d(c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(R)) + F d(c⁻¹Φ_g^{-1}(S))` with `F = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)^N`. -/
theorem theorem_1_1_paper : Stafford38Challenge.UniversalStatement.{u} := by
  intro k _ _ n d hd
  cases n with
  | zero => exact step_rank_zero d hd
  | succ n =>
      rcases section_3_reduction k hd with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨hN, g, c, -, hform, hdeg, himp⟩
      · exact h
      · obtain ⟨ell, R, S, -, h⟩ := himp (theorem_6_Q_eq_zero hN hform hdeg)
        exact ⟨ell ^ bernsteinDegree k d, R, S, h⟩

**Body of the proof of Theorem 1.1.** For `d̃` in the normal form (3.1)
with `N = deg_B d̃ ≥ 1`, `Q = A_n(k)/(d̃A_n(k) + x₁^N d̃A_n(k)) = 0`.  With

`K = k̄`: `W = ∅` by Theorem 5.8, so `gr Q_K = 0`, `Q_K = 0`, and `Q = 0` by
Lemma 6.2. -/
theorem theorem_6_Q_eq_zero [CharZero k] {n N : ℕ} {dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hform : IsMonicNormalForm k N dt) (hdeg : bernsteinDegree k dt = N) :
    Subsingleton (Q k N dt) := by
  let K := AlgebraicClosure k
  have : CharZero K := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap k K).injective
  have hW := step_W_empty (K := K) hN hform hdeg
  exact ((lemma_6_2 (K := K) (N := N) dt).2.2.1).2 (step_QK_zero (step_grQK_zero hW))

/-- `θ : K ⊗_k Q ≅ Q_K`, `c ⊗ [a] ↦ c [a]`, `K`-linear. -/
def theta62 (dt : PresentedWeyl k (n + 1)) : K ⊗[k] Q k N dt ≃ₗ[K] Q K N (dtK K dt) :=
  { (TensorProduct.comm k K (Q k N dt)).trans (step_6_2_quotient (K := K) (N := N) dt) with
    map_smul' := fun c t => by
      induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | tmul c' q =>
          obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
          simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
            LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
            smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
          rw [step_6_2_quotient_mk, step_6_2_quotient_mk, mul_smul]
          rfl
      | add x y hx hy =>
          simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
            smul_add, map_add, RingHom.id_apply] at hx hy ⊢
          rw [hx, hy] }

Stafford38.Paper.Section6.weyl_rightOreC.doc:
**`A_n(k)` is a right Ore domain** [Björk, Prop. 1.8.4]: nonzero `d₁, d₂`
have `r₁, r₂` with `d₁r₁ = d₂r₂ ≠ 0`.
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.weyl_rightOreC.signature:
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.weyl_rightOreCondition.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
  AlgebraicAnalysis.OreRightIntersection.RightOreCondition
    (WeylIteratedEquivalence.PresentedWeyl k n)
Stafford38.Paper.Section6.weyl_rightOreC.source:
/-- **`A_n(k)` is a right Ore domain** [Björk, Prop. 1.8.4]: nonzero `d₁, d₂`
have `r₁, r₂` with `d₁r₁ = d₂r₂ ≠ 0`. -/
theorem weyl_rightOreCondition (n : ℕ) :
    AlgebraicAnalysis.OreRightIntersection.RightOreCondition (PresentedWeyl k n) := by
  intro a b ha hb
  by_contra hcon
  have hab : ∀ x y : PresentedWeyl k n, a * x = b * y → a * x = 0 := by
    intro x y hxy
    by_contra hne
    exact hcon ⟨x, y, hxy, hne⟩
  obtain ⟨Na, hNa⟩ := exists_mem_bernsteinPiece k a
  obtain ⟨Nb, hNb⟩ := exists_mem_bernsteinPiece k b
  let N := max Na Nb
  have haN : a ∈ bernsteinPiece k n N :=
    presentedWeightPiece_mono k bernsteinWeight (le_max_left Na Nb) hNa
  have hbN : b ∈ bernsteinPiece k n N :=
    presentedWeightPiece_mono k bernsteinWeight (le_max_right Na Nb) hNb
  have h10 : (1 : PresentedWeyl k n) ≠ 0 := fun h => ha (by rw [← mul_one a, h, mul_zero])
  have hgrow : ∀ j : ℕ, 2 ^ j ≤ Module.finrank k (bernsteinPiece k n (j * N)) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
        have hfin := (bernsteinPiece_finite_finrank_le (k := k) n 0).1
        rw [pow_zero, zero_mul, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
        intro h0
        rw [Submodule.finrank_eq_zero] at h0
        have h1 := one_mem_bernsteinPiece_zero (k := k) n
        rw [h0, Submodule.mem_bot] at h1
        exact h10 h1
    | succ j ih =>
        have h := two_mul_finrank_le ha hb hab haN hbN (j * N)
        rw [show (j + 1) * N = N + j * N by ring, pow_succ]
        omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_pow_lt_two_pow N (Fintype.card (PhaseVar n))
  have hle := (bernsteinPiece_finite_finrank_le (k := k) n (j * N)).2
  have := hgrow j
  omega

Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1.doc:
**Theorem 1.1.** For every field `k` of characteristic zero, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)` there is `F ∈ A_n(k)` with
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, i.e. `1 = dR + FdS` for some `R, S`.
Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1.source:
/-- **Theorem 1.1.** For every field `k` of characteristic zero, every `n ≥ 0`
and every nonzero `d ∈ A_n(k)` there is `F ∈ A_n(k)` with
`A_n(k) = dA_n(k) + FdA_n(k)`, i.e. `1 = dR + FdS` for some `R, S`. -/
theorem theorem_1_1 : Stafford38Challenge.UniversalStatement.{u} :=
  Section6.theorem_1_1_paper
Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,
        a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
          b = (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))) (Matrix.J (Fin n) k i j)),
  d ≠ 0 → ∃ F R S, 1 = d * R + F * d * S

Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1_fixedSource.doc:
**Theorem 1.1, moreover.** If `n ≥ 1`, one may choose `F = ℓ^{deg_B d}`
for a linear symplectic coordinate `ℓ = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)`.

for a linear symplectic coordinate `ℓ = Φ_g^{-1}(x₁)`. -/

    Stafford38FixedSourceChallenge.UniversalFixedSourceStatement.{u} :=
  Section6.theorem_1_1_fixedSource_paper
Stafford38.Paper.theorem_1_1_fixedSource.unfolded:
∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ)
  (d :
    RingQuot fun a b =>
      ∃ i j,
        a = FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j - FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
          b =
            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)),
  d ≠ 0 →
    ∃ ell R S,
      (∃ M N,
          ∃ (_ : M * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * M.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ :
            N * Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k * N.transpose = Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k) (_ : M * N = 1)
            (_ : N * M = 1),
            ell =
              ∑ j,
                (algebraMap k
                      (RingQuot fun a b =>
                        ∃ i j,
                          a =
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                            b =
                              (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j)))
                    (N (Sum.inl 0) j) *
                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                      ∃ i j,
                        a =
                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                          b =
                            (algebraMap k (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                    (FreeAlgebra.ι k j)) ∧
        1 =
          d * R +
            ell ^
                  sInf
                    {N |
                      d ∈
                        Submodule.span k
                          {z |
                            ∃ a p,
                              ∑ i, a i + ∑ i, p i ≤ N ∧
                                z =
                                  (RingQuot.mkAlgHom k fun a b =>
                                      ∃ i j,
                                        a =
                                            FreeAlgebra.ι k i * FreeAlgebra.ι k j -
                                              FreeAlgebra.ι k j * FreeAlgebra.ι k i ∧
                                          b =
                                            (algebraMap k
                                                (FreeAlgebra k (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin (n + 1))))
                                              (Matrix.J (Fin (n + 1)) k i j))
                                    (Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x =>
                                      (Fin x → ℕ) → (Fin x → ℕ) → FreeAlgebra k (Fin x ⊕ Fin x))
                                      (n + 1)
                                      (fun x f x_1 x_2 =>
                                        Nat.casesOn (motive := fun x =>
                                          (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                            (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                              Nat.below (motive := fun x =>
                                                  (Fin x → ℕ) →
                                                    (Fin x → ℕ) → FreeAlgebra k (Fin x ⊕ Fin x))
                                                  x →
                                                FreeAlgebra k (Fin x ⊕ Fin x))
                                          x (fun x x_3 x_4 => 1)
                                          (fun n x x_3 x_4 =>
                                            ((FreeAlgebra.lift k) fun i =>
                                                    FreeAlgebra.ι k
                                                      (Sum.casesOn i (fun val => Sum.inl val.succ)
                                                        fun val => Sum.inr val.succ))
                                                  (x_4.1 (fun i => x i.succ) fun i => x_3 i.succ) *
                                                FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl 0) ^ x 0 *
                                              FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr 0) ^ x_3 0)
                                          x_1 x_2 f)
                                      a p)}} *
                d *
              S

def IsRightTorsion {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [Ring A]

Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.doc:
Stafford's *stably cyclic* [Sta78, p. 435], as quoted in the proof of
Corollary 6.3 (tex line 1619): "given `l ≥ 1` and `a_1, …, a_{l+1} ∈ T` that
generate `T`, there exist `f_i ∈ A_n` such that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`,
`i = 1, …, l`, also generate `T`".
Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.signature:

  [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] : Prop
Stafford38Challenge.IsStablyCyclic.source:
/-- Stafford's *stably cyclic* [Sta78, p. 435], as quoted in the proof of
Corollary 6.3 (tex line 1619): "given `l ≥ 1` and `a_1, …, a_{l+1} ∈ T` that
generate `T`, there exist `f_i ∈ A_n` such that `a_i + a_{l+1} f_i`,
`i = 1, …, l`, also generate `T`". -/
def IsStablyCyclic (A : Type u) (T : Type v) [Ring A] [AddCommGroup T] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ T] :
    Prop :=
  ∀ l ≥ 1, ∀ a : Fin (l + 1) → T, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range a) = ⊤ →
    ∃ f : Fin l → A, Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (Set.range fun i : Fin l => a i.castSucc + (MulOpposite.op (f i) : Aᵐᵒᵖ) • a (Fin.last l)) =
        ⊤

    (ell : WeylAlg k (n + 1)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M N : Matrix (PhaseVar (n + 1)) (PhaseVar (n + 1)) k)

        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hN : N * standardForm k (n + 1) * Matrix.transpose N =
        standardForm k (n + 1))
      (_hMN : M * N = 1) (_hNM : N * M = 1),
      ell = linearCombination k N (generator k (n + 1))
        (.inl (0 : Fin (n + 1)))

classical
  let I := idealI k N dt
  let IK := idealI K N (dtK K dt)
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace k K
    let t := (MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k K).symm g
    let c := TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b t
    have ht : t = c.sum fun l f => b l ⊗ₜ[k] f := by
      rw [← (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b).symm_apply_apply t]
      change (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b).symm.toLinearMap c = _
      rw [TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft_symm]
      simp [Finsupp.lsum_apply]
      rfl
    have hg' : g = c.sum fun l f => b l • σ k K n f := by

steps.text:
classical
  let I := idealI K N (dtK K dt)
  let 𝒜 := MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule K (@orderWeight (n + 1))
  let x0 := orderPieceToQuotientGraded K I 0 (orderPieceOne (n := n + 1) K)
  have hq : qBar K I = orderAssociatedGradedOf K I 0 x0 := rfl
  -- `π_e`, the degree-`e` component of `gr Q_K = ⊕_e Q_{K,e}/Q_{K,e-1}`.
  let π : ∀ e : ℕ, OrderAssociatedGradedModule K I →+ QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I e :=
    fun e => { toFun := fun z =>
                (show Stafford38.CharacteristicFilteredQuotientGraded.QuotientOrderAssociatedGraded
                  K I from z) e
               map_zero' := rfl
               map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  have hπ : ∀ e j (x : QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I j),
      π e (orderAssociatedGradedOf K I j x) = if h : j = e then h ▸ x else 0 := by
    intro e j x
    change (DirectSum.of _ j x : DirectSum ℕ _) e = _
    rw [DirectSum.of_apply]
  -- The degree-`(0 + d)` component of `g q̄` is `g_d q̄`.
  have hcomp : ∀ (g : SymbolRing K (n + 1)) (d : ℕ),
      ((DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 g d : SymbolRing K (n + 1))) • qBar K I =
        orderAssociatedGradedOf K I (0 + d) (π (0 + d) (g • qBar K I)) := by
    intro g d
    rw [hq, smul_orderAssociatedGradedOf_eq_of_homogeneousAction]
    congr 1
    conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 g]
    rw [Finset.sum_smul, map_sum]
    simp_rw [smul_orderAssociatedGradedOf_eq_of_homogeneousAction, hπ]
    by_cases hd : d ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 g).support
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single d]
      · simp
      · intro i _ hid
        exact dite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => absurd h (by omega)
      · exact fun h => absurd hd h
    · have hact : CharacteristicFilteredQuotientGraded.quotientOrderHomogeneousAction K I
          (0 : 𝒜 d) x0 = 0 := by
        have h0 := smul_orderAssociatedGradedOf_eq_of_homogeneousAction K I (0 : 𝒜 d) x0
        rw [Submodule.coe_zero, zero_smul] at h0
        exact DirectSum.of_injective (β := QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I) (0 + d)
          (h0.symm.trans (map_zero (DirectSum.of (QuotientOrderGradedPiece K I) (0 + d))).symm)
      rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hd, hact, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      intro i hi
      exact dite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => absurd (show i = d by omega ▸ hi) hd
  intro d g hg
  rw [Module.mem_annihilator] at hg ⊢
  intro m
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := grCyclic_generated K I m
  rw [smul_comm, hcomp, hg, map_zero]
  have h0 : orderAssociatedGradedOf K I (0 + d) 0 = (0 : OrderAssociatedGradedModule K I) :=
    map_zero _
  rw [h0]
  exact smul_zero h
